'''久津川古墳群'''（くつかわこふんぐん）は、[[京都府]][[城陽市]]平川地区周辺一帯に点在する[[古墳群]]である。京都府内の古墳群としては最大級の物である<ref>[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm 城陽市の古墳]</ref>。
== 概要 == [[近畿日本鉄道]][[久津川駅]]西側を流れる大谷川（おおたにがわ）周辺の平地部、丘陵部に位置する古墳群を指す。狭義には[[久津川車塚古墳]]周辺の10基前後の古墳を指す事もあるが、周辺丘陵部に点在する比較的小規模な古墳や古墳群を含めると、総計150基前後になるとされる<ref>[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 京都府観光ガイド 城陽市 久津川古墳群]</ref>。近年の宅地開発により、失われた物や、見えなくなっている物も少なくない<ref>[http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 文化遺産オンライン 久津川車塚・丸塚古墳]</ref>。
久津川古墳群の一部を形成する[[芝ヶ原古墳群]]の中の一つ（芝ヶ原9号墳）は、公立小学校である[[城陽市立久世小学校]]の中庭部分に保存されている。
== 主な古墳 == *[[久津川車塚古墳]] - 国の[[史跡]]。久津川古墳群の中だけでなく[[山城国|山城]]地域周辺では最大級の[[前方後円墳]]で、竜山石製の[[長持形石棺]]が発見された。 *[[久津川丸塚古墳]] - 国の史跡。[[帆立貝形古墳]]。 *[[青塚古墳 (城陽市)|青塚古墳]] - [[前方後方墳]]。 *[[赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|赤塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[平川廃寺跡]]に隣接。 *[[芭蕉塚古墳]] - [[前方後円墳]]。 *[[梶塚古墳]] - [[方墳]]。久津川車塚古墳と敷地が一部重なる。 *[[指月塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[城陽市立久津川小学校]]の敷地内にに位置する場所にかつて存在し、現在は建物の下敷きとなり失われている。 *[[箱塚古墳 (城陽市)|箱塚古墳]] - [[前方後円墳]]。 *[[山道古墳 (城陽市)|山道古墳]] - [[方墳]]。現在は住宅地となり失われている。 *[[芝ヶ原古墳群]] - 大小13基から成る古墳群。芝ヶ原12号墳は[[芝ヶ原古墳]]として国の史跡に指定された。 *[[尼塚古墳群 (城陽市)|尼塚古墳群]] - 大小7基から成る古墳群。尼塚1号墳～5号墳は住宅地となり失われ、6、7号墳は保存されている。 *[[上大谷古墳群]] - 大小20基から成る古墳群。11基が保存されている。 *[[下大谷古墳群]] - 大小2基から成る古墳群。2号墳は住宅地となり失われ、1号墳は保存されている。 *[[西山古墳群 (城陽市)|西山古墳群]] - 下大谷古墳群の近くにかつて存在したが、住宅地開発により全て失われた。 *[[大竹古墳 (城陽市)|大竹古墳]] - [[方墳]]。
== その他の遺跡等 == *[[平川廃寺跡]] - 国の史跡。[[赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|赤塚古墳]]に隣接。 *[[久世廃寺跡]] - 国の史跡。 *[[正道官衙遺跡]] - 国の史跡。
== アクセス == * [[近畿日本鉄道]] [[久津川駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。 * [[西日本旅客鉄道|JR]][[奈良線]] [[城陽駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。
== 脚注 == {{Reflist}}
== 出典 == *[http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 城陽市 公式サイト 史跡 久津川車塚・丸塚古墳の紹介ページ] *[http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html 大和國古墳墓取調室 京都府城陽市の古墳] *[http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 文化遺産オンライン 久津川車塚・丸塚古墳] *[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 京都府観光ガイド 城陽市 久津川古墳群] *[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm 城陽市の古墳] *[http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= 城陽市にある古墳]
== 関連項目 == * [[近畿の史跡一覧]]

== 主な古墳 == *[[久津川車塚古墳]] - 国の[[史跡]]。久津川古墳群の中だけでなく[[山城国|山城]]地域周辺では最大級の[[前方後円墳]]で、竜山石製の[[長持形石棺]]が発見された。 *[[丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|丸塚古墳]] - 国の史跡。[[帆立貝形古墳]]。 *[[青塚古墳 (城陽市)|青塚古墳]] - [[前方後方墳]]。 *[[赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|赤塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[平川廃寺跡]]に隣接。 *[[芭蕉塚古墳]] - 国の史跡。[[前方後円墳]]。 *[[梶塚古墳]] - [[方墳]]。久津川車塚古墳と敷地が一部重なる。 *[[指月塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[城陽市立久津川小学校]]の敷地内に位置する場所にかつて存在し、現在は建物の下敷きとなり失われている。 *[[箱塚古墳 (城陽市)|箱塚古墳]] - [[前方後円墳]]。 *[[山道古墳 (城陽市)|山道古墳]] - [[方墳]]。現在は住宅地となり失われている。 *[[芝ヶ原古墳群]] - 大小13基から成る古墳群。芝ヶ原12号墳は[[芝ヶ原古墳]]として国の史跡に指定された。 *[[尼塚古墳群 (城陽市)|尼塚古墳群]] - 大小7基から成る古墳群。尼塚1号墳～5号墳は住宅地となり失われ、6、7号墳は保存されている。 *[[上大谷古墳群]] - 大小20基から成る古墳群。11基が保存されている。 *[[下大谷古墳群]] - 大小2基から成る古墳群。2号墳は住宅地となり失われ、1号墳は保存されている。 *[[西山古墳群 (城陽市)|西山古墳群]] - 下大谷古墳群の近くにかつて存在したが、住宅地開発により全て失われた。 *[[大竹古墳 (城陽市)|大竹古墳]] - [[方墳]]。
== その他の遺跡等 == *[[平川廃寺跡]] - 国の史跡。[[赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|赤塚古墳]]に隣接。 *[[久世廃寺跡]] - 国の史跡。 *[[正道官衙遺跡]] - 国の史跡。
== アクセス == * [[近畿日本鉄道]] [[久津川駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。 * [[西日本旅客鉄道|JR]][[奈良線]] [[城陽駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。

== 概要 == [[近畿日本鉄道]][[久津川駅]]東側を流れる大谷川（おおたにがわ）周辺の平地部、丘陵部に位置する古墳群を指す。狭義には[[久津川車塚古墳]]周辺の10基前後の古墳を指す事もあるが、周辺丘陵部に点在する比較的小規模な古墳や古墳群を含めると、総計150基前後になるとされる<ref>[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 京都府観光ガイド 城陽市 久津川古墳群]</ref>。近年の宅地開発により、失われた物や、見えなくなっている物も少なくない<ref>[http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 文化遺産オンライン 久津川車塚・丸塚古墳]</ref>。
従来、[[久津川車塚古墳]]と[[丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|丸塚古墳]]の2基が「久津川車塚・丸塚古墳」の呼称で国の[[史跡]]に指定されていたが、[[2016年]]（[[平成]]28年）に[[芭蕉塚古墳]]と[[久津川小学校古墳]]が追加指定され、4基を総称する「久津川古墳群」の名称に変更された<ref name="文化庁">{{PDFlink|[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf 「史跡等の指定等について」]}}（文化庁記者発表、2016年6月17日）。</ref><ref name="告示">平成28年10月3日文部科学省告示第144号。</ref>。またそれとは別に、芝ヶ原12号墳が「[[芝ヶ原古墳]]」の名称で国の史跡に指定されている。
== 主な古墳 == *[[久津川車塚古墳]] - 国の[[史跡]]。久津川古墳群の中だけでなく[[山城国|山城]]地域周辺では最大級の[[前方後円墳]]で、竜山石製の[[長持形石棺]]が発見された。 *[[丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|丸塚古墳]] - 国の史跡。[[帆立貝形古墳]]。 *[[青塚古墳 (城陽市)|青塚古墳]] - [[前方後方墳]]。 *[[赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|赤塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[平川廃寺跡]]に隣接。 *[[芭蕉塚古墳]] - 国の史跡。[[前方後円墳]]。 *[[梶塚古墳]] - [[方墳]]。久津川車塚古墳と敷地が一部重なる。 *[[指月塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[城陽市立久津川小学校]]の敷地内に位置する場所にかつて存在し、現在は建物の下敷きとなり失われている。 *[[箱塚古墳 (城陽市)|箱塚古墳]] - [[前方後円墳]]。 *[[山道古墳 (城陽市)|山道古墳]] - [[方墳]]。現在は住宅地となり失われている。 *[[芝ヶ原古墳群]] - 大小13基から成る古墳群。芝ヶ原12号墳は「[[芝ヶ原古墳]]」として国の史跡に指定されている（史跡「久津川古墳群」には含まれない）。また芝ヶ原9号墳は「[[久津川小学校古墳]]」として国の史跡に指定された。 *[[尼塚古墳群 (城陽市)|尼塚古墳群]] - 大小7基から成る古墳群。尼塚1号墳～5号墳は住宅地となり失われ、6、7号墳は保存されている。 *[[上大谷古墳群]] - 大小20基から成る古墳群。11基が保存されている。 *[[下大谷古墳群]] - 大小2基から成る古墳群。2号墳は住宅地となり失われ、1号墳は保存されている。 *[[西山古墳群 (城陽市)|西山古墳群]] - 下大谷古墳群の近くにかつて存在したが、住宅地開発により全て失われた。 *[[大竹古墳 (城陽市)|大竹古墳]] - [[方墳]]。
== その他の遺跡等 == *[[平川廃寺跡]] - 国の史跡。[[赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|赤塚古墳]]に隣接。 *[[久世廃寺跡]] - 国の史跡。 *[[正道官衙遺跡]] - 国の史跡。
== アクセス == * [[近畿日本鉄道]] [[久津川駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。 * [[西日本旅客鉄道|JR]][[奈良線]] [[城陽駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。

古墳群|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{Center|久津川古墳群の位置}}}} [[ファイル:久津川古墳群 縮尺模型.JPG|thumb|300px|right|{{center|久津川古墳群 縮尺模型}}{{small|[[芝ヶ原古墳|史跡芝ヶ原古墳公園]]展示。古墳群を西方から望む。}}]] '''久津川古墳群'''（くつかわこふんぐん）は、[[京都府]][[城陽市]]にある[[古墳群]]。一部が国の[[史跡]]に指定されている。京都府内では最大級の古墳群である[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm 城陽市の古墳]。 == 概要 == [[近畿日本鉄道]][[久津川駅]]東側を流れる大谷川（おおたにがわ）周辺の平地部、丘陵部に位置する古墳群を指す。狭義には[[久津川車塚古墳]]周辺の10基前後の古墳を指す事もあるが、周辺丘陵部に点在する比較的小規模な古墳や古墳群を含めると、総計150基前後になるとされる[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 京都府観光ガイド 城陽市 久津川古墳群]。近年の宅地開発により、失われた物や、見えなくなっている物も少なくない[http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 文化遺産オンライン 久津川車塚・丸塚古墳]。 従来、[[久津川車塚古墳]]と[[丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|丸塚古墳]]の2基が「久津川車塚・丸塚古墳」の呼称で国の[[史跡]]に指定されていたが、[[2016年]]（[[平成]]28年）に[[芭蕉塚古墳]]と[[久世小学校古墳]]が追加指定され、4基を総称する「久津川古墳群」の名称に変更された{{PDFlink|[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf 「史跡等の指定等について」]}}（文化庁記者発表、2016年6月17日）。平成28年10月3日文部科学省告示第144号。。またこれとは別に、芝ヶ原12号墳が「[[芝ヶ原古墳]]」の名称で国の史跡に指定されている。 == 主な古墳 == *[[久津川車塚古墳]] - 国の[[史跡]]。久津川古墳群の中だけでなく[[山城国|山城]]地域周辺では最大級の[[前方後円墳]]で、竜山石製の[[長持形石棺]]が発見された。 *[[丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|丸塚古墳]] - 国の史跡。[[帆立貝形古墳]]。 *[[青塚古墳 (城陽市)|青塚古墳]] - [[前方後方墳]]。 *[[赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|赤塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[平川廃寺跡]]に隣接。 *[[芭蕉塚古墳]] - 国の史跡。[[前方後円墳]]。 *[[梶塚古墳]] - [[方墳]]。久津川車塚古墳と敷地が一部重なる。 *[[指月塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[城陽市立久津川小学校]]の敷地内に位置する場所にかつて存在し、現在は建物の下敷きとなり失われている。 *[[箱塚古墳 (城陽市)|箱塚古墳]] - [[前方後円墳]]。 *[[山道古墳 (城陽市)|山道古墳]] - [[方墳]]。現在は住宅地となり失われている。 *[[芝ヶ原古墳群]] - 大小13基から成る古墳群。芝ヶ原12号墳は「[[芝ヶ原古墳]]」として国の史跡に指定されている（史跡「久津川古墳群」には含まれない）。また[[城陽市立久世小学校]]の中庭部分に保存されている芝ヶ原9号墳は「[[久世小学校古墳]]」として国の史跡に指定された。 *[[尼塚古墳群 (城陽市)|尼塚古墳群]] - 大小7基から成る古墳群。尼塚1号墳～5号墳は住宅地となり失われ、6、7号墳は保存されている。 *[[上大谷古墳群]] - 大小20基から成る古墳群。11基が保存されている。 *[[下大谷古墳群]] - 大小2基から成る古墳群。2号墳は住宅地となり失われ、1号墳は保存されている。 *[[西山古墳群 (城陽市)|西山古墳群]] - 下大谷古墳群の近くにかつて存在したが、住宅地開発により全て失われた。 *[[大竹古墳 (城陽市)|大竹古墳]] - [[方墳]]。 == その他の遺跡等 == *[[平川廃寺跡]] - 国の史跡。[[赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|赤塚古墳]]に隣接。 *[[久世廃寺跡]] - 国の史跡。 *[[正道官衙遺跡]] - 国の史跡。 == アクセス == * [[近畿日本鉄道]] [[久津川駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。 * [[西日本旅客鉄道|JR]][[奈良線]] [[城陽駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。 == 脚注 == {{Reflist}} == 出典 == *[http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 城陽市 公式サイト 史跡　久津川車塚・丸塚古墳の紹介ページ] *[http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html 大和國古墳墓取調室 京都府城陽市の古墳] *[http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 文化遺産オンライン 久津川車塚・丸塚古墳] *[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 京都府観光ガイド 城陽市 久津川古墳群] *[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm 城陽市の古墳] *[http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= 城陽市にある古墳] == 関連項目 == * [[近畿の史跡一覧]] == 外部リンク == * {{国指定文化財等データベース|401|1741|久津川古墳群}} {{Japanese-history-stub}} {{DEFAULTSORT:くつかわこふんくん}} [[Category:古墳群]] [[Category:京都府の古墳]] [[Category:城陽市の歴史]] [[Category:京都府にある国指定の史跡]]

{{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=久津川
古墳群|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{Center|久津川古墳群の位置}}}} '''久津川古墳群'''（くつかわこふんぐん）は、[[京都府]][[城陽市]]にある[[古墳群]]。一部が国の[[史跡]]に指定されている。京都府内では最大級の古墳群である[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm 城陽市の古墳]。 == 概要 == [[近畿日本鉄道]][[久津川駅]]東側を流れる大谷川（おおたにがわ）周辺の平地部、丘陵部に位置する古墳群を指す。狭義には[[久津川車塚古墳]]周辺の10基前後の古墳を指す事もあるが、周辺丘陵部に点在する比較的小規模な古墳や古墳群を含めると、総計150基前後になるとされる[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 京都府観光ガイド 城陽市 久津川古墳群]。近年の宅地開発により、失われた物や、見えなくなっている物も少なくない[http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 文化遺産オンライン 久津川車塚・丸塚古墳]。 従来、[[久津川車塚古墳]]と[[丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|丸塚古墳]]の2基が「久津川車塚・丸塚古墳」の呼称で国の[[史跡]]に指定されていたが、[[2016年]]（[[平成]]28年）に[[芭蕉塚古墳]]と[[久世小学校古墳]]が追加指定され、4基を総称する「久津川古墳群」の名称に変更された{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf 「史跡等の指定等について」]}}（文化庁記者発表、2016年6月17日）。平成28年10月3日文部科学省告示第144号。。またこれとは別に、芝ヶ原12号墳が「[[芝ヶ原古墳]]」の名称で国の史跡に指定されている。 == 主な古墳 == *[[久津川車塚古墳]] - 国の[[史跡]]。久津川古墳群の中だけでなく[[山城国|山城]]地域周辺では最大級の[[前方後円墳]]で、竜山石製の[[長持形石棺]]が発見された。 *[[丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|丸塚古墳]] - 国の史跡。[[帆立貝形古墳]]。 *[[青塚古墳 (城陽市)|青塚古墳]] - [[前方後方墳]]。 *[[赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|赤塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[平川廃寺跡]]に隣接。 *[[芭蕉塚古墳]] - 国の史跡。[[前方後円墳]]。 *[[梶塚古墳]] - [[方墳]]。久津川車塚古墳と敷地が一部重なる。 *[[指月塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[城陽市立久津川小学校]]の敷地内に位置する場所にかつて存在し、現在は建物の下敷きとなり失われている。 *[[箱塚古墳 (城陽市)|箱塚古墳]] - [[前方後円墳]]。 *[[山道古墳 (城陽市)|山道古墳]] - [[方墳]]。現在は住宅地となり失われている。 *[[芝ヶ原古墳群]] - 大小13基から成る古墳群。芝ヶ原12号墳は「[[芝ヶ原古墳]]」として国の史跡に指定されている（史跡「久津川古墳群」には含まれない）。また[[城陽市立久世小学校]]の中庭部分に保存されている芝ヶ原9号墳は「[[久世小学校古墳]]」として国の史跡に指定された。 *[[尼塚古墳群 (城陽市)|尼塚古墳群]] - 大小7基から成る古墳群。尼塚1号墳～5号墳は住宅地となり失われ、6、7号墳は保存されている。 *[[上大谷古墳群]] - 大小20基から成る古墳群。11基が保存されている。 *[[下大谷古墳群]] - 大小2基から成る古墳群。2号墳は住宅地となり失われ、1号墳は保存されている。 *[[西山古墳群 (城陽市)|西山古墳群]] - 下大谷古墳群の近くにかつて存在したが、住宅地開発により全て失われた。 *[[大竹古墳 (城陽市)|大竹古墳]] - [[方墳]]。 == その他の遺跡等 == *[[平川廃寺跡]] - 国の史跡。[[赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|赤塚古墳]]に隣接。 *[[久世廃寺跡]] - 国の史跡。 *[[正道官衙遺跡]] - 国の史跡。 == アクセス == * [[近畿日本鉄道]] [[久津川駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。 * [[西日本旅客鉄道|JR]][[奈良線]] [[城陽駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。 == 脚注 == {{Reflist}} == 出典 == *[http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 城陽市 公式サイト 史跡　久津川車塚・丸塚古墳の紹介ページ] *[http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html 大和國古墳墓取調室 京都府城陽市の古墳] *[http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 文化遺産オンライン 久津川車塚・丸塚古墳] *[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 京都府観光ガイド 城陽市 久津川古墳群] *[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm 城陽市の古墳] *[http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= 城陽市にある古墳] == 関連項目 == * [[近畿地方の史跡一覧]] == 外部リンク == * {{国指定文化財等データベース|401|1741|久津川古墳群}} {{Japanese-history-stub}} {{DEFAULTSORT:くつかわこふんくん}} [[Category:古墳群]] [[Category:京都府の古墳]] [[Category:城陽市の歴史]] [[Category:京都府にある国指定の史跡]]

国の史跡。[[前方後円墳]]。 *[[梶塚古墳]] - [[方墳]]。久津川車塚古墳と敷地が一部重なる。 *[[指月塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[城陽市立久津川小学校]]の敷地内に位置する場所にかつて存在し、現在は建物の下敷きとなり失われている。 *[[箱塚古墳 (城陽市)|箱塚古墳]] - [[前方後円墳]]。 *[[山道古墳 (城陽市)|山道古墳]] - [[方墳]]。現在は住宅地となり失われている。 *[[芝ヶ原古墳群]] - 大小13基から成る古墳群。芝ヶ原12号墳は「[[芝ヶ原古墳]]」として国の史跡に指定されている（史跡「久津川古墳群」には含まれない）。また[[城陽市立久世小学校]]の中庭部分に保存されている芝ヶ原9号墳は「[[久世小学校古墳]]」として国の史跡に指定された。 *[[尼塚古墳群 (城陽市)|尼塚古墳群]] - 大小7基から成る古墳群。尼塚1号墳～5号墳は住宅地となり失われ、6、7号墳は保存されている。 *[[上大谷古墳群]] - 大小20基から成る古墳群。11基が保存されている。 *[[下大谷古墳群]] - 大小2基から成る古墳群。2号墳は住宅地となり失われ、1号墳は保存されている。 *[[西山古墳群 (城陽市)|西山古墳群]] - 下大谷古墳群の近くにかつて存在したが、住宅地開発により全て失われた。 *[[大竹古墳 (城陽市)|大竹古墳]] - [[方墳]]。 == その他の遺跡等 == *[[平川廃寺跡]] - 国の史跡。[[赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|赤塚古墳]]に隣接。 *[[久世廃寺跡]] - 国の史跡。 *[[正道官衙遺跡]] - 国の史跡。 == アクセス == * [[近畿日本鉄道]] [[久津川駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。 * [[西日本旅客鉄道|JR]][[奈良線]] [[城陽駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。 == 脚注 == {{Reflist}} == 出典 == *[http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 城陽市 公式サイト 史跡　久津川車塚・丸塚古墳の紹介ページ] *[http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html 大和國古墳墓取調室 京都府城陽市の古墳] *[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 文化遺産オンライン 久津川車塚・丸塚古墳] *[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 京都府観光ガイド 城陽市 久津川古墳群] *[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm 城陽市の古墳] *[http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= 城陽市にある古墳] == 関連項目 == * [[近畿地方の史跡一覧]] == 外部リンク == * {{国指定文化財等データベース|401|1741|久津川古墳群}} {{Japanese-history-stub}} {{DEFAULTSORT:くつかわこふんくん}} [[Category:久津川古墳群|*]] [[Category:古墳群]] [[Category:京都府の古墳]] [[Category:城陽市の歴史]] [[Category:京都府にある国指定の史跡]]

古墳群|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{Center|久津川古墳群の位置}}}} '''久津川古墳群'''（くつかわこふんぐん）は、[[京都府]][[城陽市]]にある[[古墳群]]。一部が国の[[史跡]]に指定されている。京都府内では最大級の古墳群である[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm 城陽市の古墳]。 == 概要 == [[近畿日本鉄道]][[久津川駅]]東側を流れる大谷川（おおたにがわ）周辺の平地部、丘陵部に位置する古墳群を指す。狭義には[[久津川車塚古墳]]周辺の10基前後の古墳を指す事もあるが、周辺丘陵部に点在する比較的小規模な古墳や古墳群を含めると、総計150基前後になるとされる[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 京都府観光ガイド 城陽市 久津川古墳群]。近年の宅地開発により、失われた物や、見えなくなっている物も少なくない[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 文化遺産オンライン 久津川車塚・丸塚古墳]。 従来、[[久津川車塚古墳]]と[[丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|丸塚古墳]]の2基が「久津川車塚・丸塚古墳」の呼称で国の[[史跡]]に指定されていたが、[[2016年]]（[[平成]]28年）に[[芭蕉塚古墳]]と[[久世小学校古墳]]が追加指定され、4基を総称する「久津川古墳群」の名称に変更された{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf 「史跡等の指定等について」]}}（文化庁記者発表、2016年6月17日）。平成28年10月3日文部科学省告示第144号。。またこれとは別に、芝ヶ原12号墳が「[[芝ヶ原古墳]]」の名称で国の史跡に指定されている。 == 主な古墳 == *[[久津川車塚古墳]] - 国の[[史跡]]。久津川古墳群の中だけでなく[[山城国|山城]]地域周辺では最大級の[[前方後円墳]]で、竜山石製の[[長持形石棺]]が発見された。 *[[丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|丸塚古墳]] - 国の史跡。[[帆立貝形古墳]]。 *[[青塚古墳 (城陽市)|青塚古墳]] - [[前方後方墳]]。 *[[赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|赤塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[平川廃寺跡]]に隣接。 *[[芭蕉塚古墳]] - 国の史跡。[[前方後円墳]]。 *[[梶塚古墳]] - [[方墳]]。久津川車塚古墳と敷地が一部重なる。 *[[指月塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[城陽市立久津川小学校]]の敷地内に位置する場所にかつて存在し、現在は建物の下敷きとなり失われている。 *[[箱塚古墳 (城陽市)|箱塚古墳]] - [[前方後円墳]]。 *[[山道古墳 (城陽市)|山道古墳]] - [[方墳]]。現在は住宅地となり失われている。 *[[芝ヶ原古墳群]] - 大小13基から成る古墳群。芝ヶ原12号墳は「[[芝ヶ原古墳]]」として国の史跡に指定されている（史跡「久津川古墳群」には含まれない）。また[[城陽市立久世小学校]]の中庭部分に保存されている芝ヶ原9号墳は「[[久世小学校古墳]]」として国の史跡に指定された。 *[[尼塚古墳群 (城陽市)|尼塚古墳群]] - 大小7基から成る古墳群。尼塚1号墳～5号墳は住宅地となり失われ、6、7号墳は保存されている。 *[[上大谷古墳群]] - 内訳は[[芝ヶ原古墳]]参照。城陽市歴史民俗資料館保管。1990年（平成2年）6月29日指定{{国指定文化財等データベース|201|10078|京都府芝ケ原古墳出土品}}。 * 長持形石棺 京都府城陽市久津川車塚古墳出土（考古資料） - 附指定は[[久津川車塚古墳]]参照。[[京都大学]]保管。1991年（平成3年）6月21日指定{{国指定文化財等データベース|201|10083|長持形石棺／京都府城陽市久津川車塚古墳出土}}。 === 国の史跡 === * 久津川古墳群 ** 久津川車塚古墳 ** 丸塚古墳 ** 芭蕉塚古墳 ** 久世小学校古墳 *: 1979年（昭和54年）1月19日、「久津川車塚・丸塚古墳」として国の史跡に指定。 *: 2016年（平成28年）10月3日、芭蕉塚古墳・久世小学校古墳の古墳2基を追加指定して、指定名称を「久津川古墳群」に変更{{国指定文化財等データベース|401|1741|久津川古墳群}}。 * 芝ヶ原古墳 *: 1989年（平成元年）9月6日指定。 *: 2012年（平成24年）1月24日に史跡範囲の追加指定{{国指定文化財等データベース|401|1750|芝ヶ原古墳}}。 === 城陽市指定文化財 === * 有形文化財 ** 芝ケ原11号墳出土品（考古資料） ファイル:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡
{{small|城陽市歴史民俗資料館（五里ごり館）展示。}} == アクセス == * [[近畿日本鉄道]] [[久津川駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。 * [[西日本旅客鉄道|JR]][[奈良線]] [[城陽駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。 == 脚注 == {{Reflist}} == 出典 == *[http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 城陽市 公式サイト 史跡　久津川車塚・丸塚古墳の紹介ページ] *[http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html 大和國古墳墓取調室 京都府城陽市の古墳] *[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 文化遺産オンライン 久津川車塚・丸塚古墳] *[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 京都府観光ガイド 城陽市 久津川古墳群] *[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm 城陽市の古墳] *[http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= 城陽市にある古墳] == 関連項目 == * [[近畿地方の史跡一覧]] == 外部リンク == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Group}} * {{国指定文化財等データベース|401|1741|久津川古墳群}} {{Japanese-history-stub}} {{DEFAULTSORT:くつかわこふんくん}} [[Category:久津川古墳群|*]] [[Category:古墳群]] [[Category:京都府の古墳]] [[Category:城陽市の歴史]] [[Category:京都府にある国指定の史跡]]

revision.text:
{{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Cluster|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of [[kofun]] burial mounds located in {{ill|Joyo|ja|城陽市}}, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of burial mounds is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}} and {{ill|Marutsuka Kofun|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * **{{ill|Marutsuka Kofun|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * **{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Rectangular front and rear burial mound. * **{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Round burial mound adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}. * **{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Kajizuka Kofun** - Square burial mound partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * **Shigetsuzuka Kofun** - Round burial mound previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校}} but now lost due to construction. * **Hakozuka Kofun** - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Yamamichi Kofun** - Square burial mound lost due to residential development. * **{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群}}** - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}}." * **{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群}}** - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * **Kami-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * **Shimo-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * **{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)}}** - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * **Otakeshi Kofun** - Square burial mound. * **Anjiyama Kofun** - Round burial mound. == Other Sites == * **{{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * **{{ill|Kuse Temple Ruins|ja|久世廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site. * **{{ill|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins|ja|正道官衙遺跡}}** - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * **Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at {{ill|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum|ja|泉屋博古館}}. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * **Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * **Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * **Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster** ** Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ** Marutsuka Kofun ** Basho-zuka Kofun ** Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * **Shibagahara Kofun** *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * **Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun
{{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}} Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|JR West Nara Line|ja|奈良線}} Joyo Station. == References == {{Reflist}} == Sources == * [http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 Official Page on Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html Ancient Burial Mounds of Joyo City] * [https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] * [http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] * [http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= List of Kofun in Joyo City] == See Also == * [[List of Historic Sites in the Kinki Region]] == External Links == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Group}} * {{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster|*]] [[Category:Kofun Clusters]] [[Category:Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:History of Joyo City]] [[Category:National Historic Sites in Kyoto Prefecture]]

Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of burial mounds is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * **{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * **{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Rectangular front and rear burial mound. * **{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Round burial mound adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}. * **{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Kajizuka Kofun** - Square burial mound partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * **Shigetsuzuka Kofun** - Round burial mound previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校}} but now lost due to construction. * **Hakozuka Kofun** - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Yamamichi Kofun** - Square burial mound lost due to residential development. * **{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群}}** - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}}." * **{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群}}** - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * **Kami-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * **Shimo-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * **{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)}}** - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * **Otakeshi Kofun** - Square burial mound. * **Anjiyama Kofun** - Round burial mound. == Other Sites == * **{{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * **{{ill|Kuse Temple Ruins|ja|久世廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site. * **{{ill|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins|ja|正道官衙遺跡}}** - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * **Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at {{ill|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum|ja|泉屋博古館}}. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * **Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * **Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * **Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster** ** Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ** Marutsuka Kofun ** Basho-zuka Kofun ** Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * **Shibagahara Kofun** *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * **Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun

{{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Cluster|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of [[kofun]] burial mounds located in {{ill|Joyo|ja|城陽市}}, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of burial mounds is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * **{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * **{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Rectangular front and rear burial mound. * **{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Round burial mound adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}. * **{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Kajizuka Kofun** - Square burial mound partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * **Shigetsuzuka Kofun** - Round burial mound previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校}} but now lost due to construction. * **Hakozuka Kofun** - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Yamamichi Kofun** - Square burial mound lost due to residential development. * **{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群}}** - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}}." * **{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群}}** - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * **Kami-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * **Shimo-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * **{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)}}** - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * **Otakeshi Kofun** - Square burial mound. * **{{ill|Anjiyama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳}}** - Round burial mound. == Other Sites == * **{{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * **{{ill|Kuse Temple Ruins|ja|久世廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site. * **{{ill|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins|ja|正道官衙遺跡}}** - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * **Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at {{ill|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum|ja|泉屋博古館}}. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * **Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * **Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * **Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster** ** Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ** Marutsuka Kofun ** Basho-zuka Kofun ** Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * **Shibagahara Kofun** *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * **Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun
{{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}} Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|JR West Nara Line|ja|奈良線}} Joyo Station. == References == {{Reflist}} == Sources == * [http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 Official Page on Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html Ancient Burial Mounds of Joyo City] * [https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] * [http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] * [http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= List of Kofun in Joyo City] == See Also == * [[List of Historic Sites in the Kinki Region]] == External Links == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Group}} * {{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster|*]] [[Category:Kofun Clusters]] [[Category:Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:History of Joyo City]] [[Category:National Historic Sites in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:Redlink Kofun]] [[Category:Kk]][[Category:original pages]][[Category:01-17]][[ja:久津川古墳群]]

Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of burial mounds is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of burial mounds is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * **{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * **{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Rectangular front and rear burial mound. * **{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Round burial mound adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}. * **{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Kajizuka Kofun** - Square burial mound partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * **Shigetsuzuka Kofun** - Round burial mound previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校}} but now lost due to construction. * **Hakozuka Kofun** - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Yamamichi Kofun** - Square burial mound lost due to residential development. * **{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群}}** - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}}." * **{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群}}** - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * **Kami-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * **Shimo-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * **{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)}}** - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * **Otakeshi Kofun** - Square burial mound. * **{{ill|Anjiyama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳}}** - Round burial mound. == Other Sites == * **{{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * **{{ill|Kuse Temple Ruins|ja|久世廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site. * **{{ill|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins|ja|正道官衙遺跡}}** - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * **Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at {{ill|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum|ja|泉屋博古館}}. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * **Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * **Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * **Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster** ** Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ** Marutsuka Kofun ** Basho-zuka Kofun ** Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * **Shibagahara Kofun** *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * **Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun
{{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}} Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|JR West Nara Line|ja|奈良線}} Joyo Station. == References == {{Reflist}} == Sources == * [http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 Official Page on Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html Ancient Burial Mounds of Joyo City] * [https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] * [http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] * [http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= List of Kofun in Joyo City] == See Also == * [[List of Historic Sites in the Kinki Region]] == External Links == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Group}} * {{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster|*]] [[Category:Kofun Clusters]] [[Category:Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:History of Joyo City]] [[Category:National Historic Sites in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:Link complete]] [[category:unsorted completion categories]] [[Category:01-17]][[Category:unsorted link categories]][[category:unsorted completion categories]][[ja:久津川古墳群]]

{{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Cluster|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of [[kofun]] burial mounds located in {{ill|Joyo|ja|城陽市}}, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of burial mounds is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * **{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * **{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Rectangular front and rear burial mound. * **{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Round burial mound adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}. * **{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Kajizuka Kofun** - Square burial mound partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * **Shigetsuzuka Kofun** - Round burial mound previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校}} but now lost due to construction. * **Hakozuka Kofun** - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Yamamichi Kofun** - Square burial mound lost due to residential development. * **{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群}}** - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}}." * **{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群}}** - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * **Kami-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * **Shimo-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * **{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)}}** - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * **Otakeshi Kofun** - Square burial mound. * **{{ill|Anjiyama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳}}** - Round burial mound. == Other Sites == * **{{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * **{{ill|Kuse Temple Ruins|ja|久世廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site. * **{{ill|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins|ja|正道官衙遺跡}}** - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * **Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at {{ill|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum|ja|泉屋博古館}}. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * **Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * **Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * **Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster** ** Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ** Marutsuka Kofun ** Basho-zuka Kofun ** Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * **Shibagahara Kofun** *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * **Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun
{{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}} Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|JR West Nara Line|ja|奈良線}} Joyo Station. == References == {{Reflist}} == Sources == * [http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 Official Page on Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html Ancient Burial Mounds of Joyo City] * [https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] * [http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] * [http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= List of Kofun in Joyo City] == See Also == * [[List of Historic Sites in the Kinki Region]] == External Links == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Group}} * {{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster|*]] [[Category:Kofun Clusters]] [[Category:Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:History of Joyo City]] [[Category:National Historic Sites in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:Link complete]] [[category:unsorted completion categories]] [[Category:01-17]][[category:unsorted completion categories]] [[Category:kk]] [[ja:久津川古墳群]]

In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. {{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Cluster|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of [[kofun]] burial mounds located in {{ill|Joyo|ja|城陽市}}, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of burial mounds is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * **{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * **{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Rectangular front and rear burial mound. * **{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Round burial mound adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}. * **{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Kajizuka Kofun** - Square burial mound partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * **Shigetsuzuka Kofun** - Round burial mound previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校}} but now lost due to construction. * **Hakozuka Kofun** - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Yamamichi Kofun** - Square burial mound lost due to residential development. * **{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群}}** - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}}." * **{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群}}** - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * **Kami-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * **Shimo-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * **{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)}}** - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * **Otakeshi Kofun** - Square burial mound. * **{{ill|Anjiyama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳}}** - Round burial mound. == Other Sites == * **{{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * **{{ill|Kuse Temple Ruins|ja|久世廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site. * **{{ill|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins|ja|正道官衙遺跡}}** - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * **Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at {{ill|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum|ja|泉屋博古館}}. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * **Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * **Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * **Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster** ** Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ** Marutsuka Kofun ** Basho-zuka Kofun ** Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * **Shibagahara Kofun** *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * **Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun
{{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}} Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|JR West Nara Line|ja|奈良線}} Joyo Station. == References == {{Reflist}} == Sources == * [http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 Official Page on Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html Ancient Burial Mounds of Joyo City] * [https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] * [http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] * [http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= List of Kofun in Joyo City] == See Also == * [[List of Historic Sites in the Kinki Region]] == External Links == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Group}} * {{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster|*]] [[Category:Kofun Clusters]] [[Category:Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:History of Joyo City]] {{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Cluster|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of [[kofun]] burial mounds located in {{ill|Joyo|ja|城陽市}}, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of burial mounds is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * **{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * **{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Rectangular front and rear burial mound. * **{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Round burial mound adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}. * **{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Kajizuka Kofun** - Square burial mound partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * **Shigetsuzuka Kofun** - Round burial mound previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校}} but now lost due to construction. * **Hakozuka Kofun** - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Yamamichi Kofun** - Square burial mound lost due to residential development. * **{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群}}** - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}}." * **{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群}}** - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * **Kami-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * **Shimo-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * **{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)}}** - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * **Otakeshi Kofun** - Square burial mound. * **{{ill|Anjiyama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳}}** - Round burial mound. == Other Sites == * **{{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * **{{ill|Kuse Temple Ruins|ja|久世廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site. * **{{ill|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins|ja|正道官衙遺跡}}** - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * **Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at {{ill|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum|ja|泉屋博古館}}. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * **Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * **Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * **Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster** ** Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ** Marutsuka Kofun ** Basho-zuka Kofun ** Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * **Shibagahara Kofun** *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * **Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun
{{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}} Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|JR West Nara Line|ja|奈良線}} Joyo Station. == References == {{Reflist}} == Sources == * [http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 Official Page on Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html Ancient Burial Mounds of Joyo City] * [https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] * [http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] * [http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= {{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Cluster|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of [[kofun]] burial mounds located in {{ill|Joyo|ja|城陽市}}, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of burial mounds is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * **{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * **{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Rectangular front and rear burial mound. * **{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Round burial mound adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}. * **{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Kajizuka Kofun** - Square burial mound partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * **Shigetsuzuka Kofun** - Round burial mound previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校}} but now lost due to construction. * **Hakozuka Kofun** - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Yamamichi Kofun** - Square burial mound lost due to residential development. * **{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群}}** - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}}." * **{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群}}** - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * **Kami-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * **Shimo-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * **{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)}}** - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * **Otakeshi Kofun** - Square burial mound. * **{{ill|Anjiyama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳}}** - Round burial mound. == Other Sites == * **{{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * **{{ill|Kuse Temple Ruins|ja|久世廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site. * **{{ill|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins|ja|正道官衙遺跡}}** - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * **Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at {{ill|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum|ja|泉屋博古館}}. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * **Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * **Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * **Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster** ** Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ** Marutsuka Kofun ** Basho-zuka Kofun ** Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * **Shibagahara Kofun** *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * **Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun
{{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}} Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|JR West Nara Line|ja|奈良線}} Joyo Station. == References == {{Reflist}} == Sources == * [http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 Official Page on Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] * Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of burial mounds is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun."
