Kofun Cluster|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of [[kofun]] Kofuns located in {{ill|Joyo|ja|城陽市|12=draft}}, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道|12=draft}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|12=draft}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of Kofuns is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|12=draft}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|12=draft}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|12=draft}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|12=draft}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳|12=draft}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺|1=Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|12=draft}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * **{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * **{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)|12=draft}}** - Rectangular front and rear Kofun. * **{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|12=draft}}** - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|12=draft}} adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡|12=draft}}. * **{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Kajizuka Kofun** - Square Kofun partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * **Shigetsuzuka Kofun** - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|12=draft}} previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校|12=draft}} but now lost due to construction. * **Hakozuka Kofun** - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Yamamichi Kofun** - Square Kofun lost due to residential development. * **{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群|12=draft}}** - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳|12=draft}}," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校|12=draft}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|12=draft}}." * **{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群|12=draft}}** - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * **Kami-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * **Shimo-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of two kofun. {{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Cluster|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of [[kofun]] Kofuns located in {{ill|Joyo|ja|城陽市|12=draft}}, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道|12=draft}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|12=draft}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of Kofuns is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|12=draft}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|12=draft}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|12=draft}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|12=draft}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳|12=draft}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺|1=Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|12=draft}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * **{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * **{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)|12=draft}}** - Rectangular front and rear Kofun. * **{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|12=draft}}** - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|12=draft}} adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡|12=draft}}. * **{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Kajizuka Kofun** - Square Kofun partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * **Shigetsuzuka Kofun** - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|12=draft}} previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校|12=draft}} but now lost due to construction. * **Hakozuka Kofun** - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Yamamichi Kofun** - Square Kofun lost due to residential development. * **{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群|12=draft}}** - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳|12=draft}}," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校|12=draft}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|12=draft}}." * **{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群|12=draft}}** - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * **Kami-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * **Shimo-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * **{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)|12=draft}}** - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * **Otakeshi Kofun** - Square Kofun. * **{{ill|Anjiyama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳|12=draft}}** - Round Kofun. == Other Sites == * **{{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * **{{ill|Kuse Temple Ruins|ja|久世廃寺跡|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site. * **{{ill|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins|ja|正道官衙遺跡|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * **Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at {{ill|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum|ja|泉屋博古館|12=draft}}. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * **Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|burial goods Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * **Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * **Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster** ** Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ** Marutsuka Kofun ** Basho-zuka Kofun ** Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * **Shibagahara Kofun** *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * **Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun
{{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道|12=draft}} Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|JR West Nara Line|ja|奈良線|12=draft}} Joyo Station. == References == {{Reflist}} == Sources == * [http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 {{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Cluster|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of [[kofun]] Kofuns located in {{ill|Joyo|ja|城陽市|12=draft}}, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道|12=draft}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|12=draft}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of Kofuns is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|12=draft}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|12=draft}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|12=draft}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|12=draft}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳|12=draft}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺|1=Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|12=draft}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * **{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * **{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)|12=draft}}** - Rectangular front and rear Kofun. * **{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|12=draft}}** - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|12=draft}} adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡|12=draft}}. * **{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Kajizuka Kofun** - Square Kofun partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * **Shigetsuzuka Kofun** - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|12=draft}} previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校|12=draft}} but now lost due to construction. * **Hakozuka Kofun** - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Yamamichi Kofun** - Square Kofun lost due to residential development. * **{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群|12=draft}}** - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳|12=draft}}," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校|12=draft}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|12=draft}}." * **{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群|12=draft}}** - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * **Kami-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * **Shimo-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * **{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)|12=draft}}** - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * **Otakeshi Kofun** - Square Kofun. * **{{ill|Anjiyama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳|12=draft}}** - Round Kofun. == Other Sites == * **{{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * **{{ill|Kuse Temple Ruins|ja|久世廃寺跡|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site. * **{{ill|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins|ja|正道官衙遺跡|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * **Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at {{ill|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum|ja|泉屋博古館|12=draft}}. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * **Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|burial goods Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * **Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * **Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster** ** Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ** Marutsuka Kofun ** Basho-zuka Kofun ** Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * **Shibagahara Kofun** *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * **Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun
{{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道|12=draft}} Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of Kofuns is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. {{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}} Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|JR West Nara Line|ja|奈良線}} Joyo Station. == References == {{Reflist}} == Sources == * [http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 Official Page on Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html Ancient Kofuns of Joyo City] * [https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] * [http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] * [http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= List of Kofun in Joyo City] == See Also == * [[List of Historic Sites in the Kinki Region]] == External Links == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Group}} * {{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} {{draft categories| }} {{citation needed|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} {{Kofun navbar}} {{draft categories| [[Category:Kofun template and pages that transclude it]] [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster|*]] [[Category:Kofun Clusters]] [[Category:Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:History of Joyo City]] [[Category:National Historic Sites in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:Completion tier 4]] [[Category:11]] [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[Category:null edit to force updates]] [[Category:Fixed Kofun templates]] }} [[sn:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[ja:久津川古墳群]]

{{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Cluster|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of [[kofun]] Kofuns located in {{ill|Joyo|ja|城陽市}}, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of Kofuns is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺|1=Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * **{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * **{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Rectangular front and rear Kofun. * **{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳}} adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}. * **{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Kajizuka Kofun** - Square Kofun partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * **Shigetsuzuka Kofun** - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳}} previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校}} but now lost due to construction. * **Hakozuka Kofun** - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Yamamichi Kofun** - Square Kofun lost due to residential development. * **{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群}}** - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}}." * **{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群}}** - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * **Kami-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * **Shimo-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * **{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)}}** - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * **Otakeshi Kofun** - Square Kofun. * **{{ill|Anjiyama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳}}** - Round Kofun. == Other Sites == * **{{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * **{{ill|Kuse Temple Ruins|ja|久世廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site. * **{{ill|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins|ja|正道官衙遺跡}}** - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * **Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at {{ill|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum|ja|泉屋博古館}}. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * **Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|burial goods Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * **Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * **Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster** ** Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ** Marutsuka Kofun ** Basho-zuka Kofun ** Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * **Shibagahara Kofun** *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * **Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun
{{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}} Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|JR West Nara Line|ja|奈良線}} Joyo Station. == References == {{Reflist}} == Sources == * [http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 Official Page on Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html Ancient Kofuns of Joyo City] * [https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] * [http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] * [http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= List of Kofun in Joyo City] == See Also == * [[List of Historic Sites in the Kinki Region]] == External Links == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Group}} * {{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} {{draft categories| }} {{citation needed|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} {{Kofun navbar}} {{draft categories| [[Category:Kofun template and pages that transclude it]] [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster|*]] [[Category:Kofun Clusters]] [[Category:Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:History of Joyo City]] [[Category:National Historic Sites in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:Completion tier 4]] [[Category:11]] [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[Category:null edit to force updates]] [[Category:Fixed Kofun templates]] }} [[sn:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[ja:久津川古墳群]]

revision.text:
{{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=久津川
古墳群|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{Center|久津川古墳群の位置}}}} '''久津川古墳群'''（くつかわこふんぐん）は、[[京都府]][[城陽市]]にある[[古墳群]]。一部が国の[[史跡]]に指定されている。京都府内では最大級の古墳群である[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm 城陽市の古墳]。 == 概要 == [[近畿日本鉄道]][[久津川駅]]東側を流れる大谷川（おおたにがわ）周辺の平地部、丘陵部に位置する古墳群を指す。狭義には[[久津川車塚古墳]]周辺の10基前後の古墳を指す事もあるが、周辺丘陵部に点在する比較的小規模な古墳や古墳群を含めると、総計150基前後になるとされる[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 京都府観光ガイド 城陽市 久津川古墳群]。近年の宅地開発により、失われた物や、見えなくなっている物も少なくない[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 文化遺産オンライン 久津川車塚・丸塚古墳]。 従来、[[久津川車塚古墳]]と[[丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|丸塚古墳]]の2基が「久津川車塚・丸塚古墳」の呼称で国の[[史跡]]に指定されていたが、[[2016年]]（[[平成]]28年）に[[芭蕉塚古墳]]と[[久世小学校古墳]]が追加指定され、4基を総称する「久津川古墳群」の名称に変更された{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf 「史跡等の指定等について」]}}（文化庁記者発表、2016年6月17日）。平成28年10月3日文部科学省告示第144号。。またこれとは別に、芝ヶ原12号墳が「[[芝ヶ原古墳]]」の名称で国の史跡に指定されている。 == 主な古墳 == *[[久津川車塚古墳]] - 国の[[史跡]]。久津川古墳群の中だけでなく[[山城国|山城]]地域周辺では最大級の[[前方後円墳]]で、竜山石製の[[長持形石棺]]が発見された。 *[[丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|丸塚古墳]] - 国の史跡。[[帆立貝形古墳]]。 *[[青塚古墳 (城陽市)|青塚古墳]] - [[前方後方墳]]。 *[[赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|赤塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[平川廃寺跡]]に隣接。 *[[芭蕉塚古墳]] - 国の史跡。[[前方後円墳]]。 *[[梶塚古墳]] - [[方墳]]。久津川車塚古墳と敷地が一部重なる。 *[[指月塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[城陽市立久津川小学校]]の敷地内に位置する場所にかつて存在し、現在は建物の下敷きとなり失われている。 *[[箱塚古墳 (城陽市)|箱塚古墳]] - [[前方後円墳]]。 *[[山道古墳 (城陽市)|山道古墳]] - [[方墳]]。現在は住宅地となり失われている。 *[[芝ヶ原古墳群]] - 大小13基から成る古墳群。芝ヶ原12号墳は「[[芝ヶ原古墳]]」として国の史跡に指定されている（史跡「久津川古墳群」には含まれない）。また[[城陽市立久世小学校]]の中庭部分に保存されている芝ヶ原9号墳は「[[久世小学校古墳]]」として国の史跡に指定された。 *[[尼塚古墳群 (城陽市)|尼塚古墳群]] - 大小7基から成る古墳群。尼塚1号墳～5号墳は住宅地となり失われ、6、7号墳は保存されている。 *[[上大谷古墳群]] - 大小20基から成る古墳群。11基が保存されている。 *[[下大谷古墳群]] - 大小2基から成る古墳群。2号墳は住宅地となり失われ、1号墳は保存されている。 *[[西山古墳群 (城陽市)|西山古墳群]] - 下大谷古墳群の近くにかつて存在したが、住宅地開発により全て失われた。 *[[大竹古墳 (城陽市)|大竹古墳]] - [[方墳]]。 *[[庵寺山古墳]] - 円墳 == その他の遺跡等 == *[[平川廃寺跡]] - 国の史跡。[[赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|赤塚古墳]]に隣接。 *[[久世廃寺跡]] - 国の史跡。 *[[正道官衙遺跡]] - 国の史跡。 == 文化財 == === 重要文化財（国指定） === * 山城国久世郡久津川車塚古墳出土鏡 7面（考古資料） - 内訳は[[久津川車塚古墳]]参照。[[泉屋博古館]]保管。1953年（昭和28年）11月14日指定{{国指定文化財等データベース|201|9721|山城国久世郡久津川車塚古墳出土鏡}}。 * 京都府芝ケ原古墳出土品 一括（考古資料） - 内訳は[[芝ヶ原古墳]]参照。城陽市歴史民俗資料館保管。1990年（平成2年）6月29日指定{{国指定文化財等データベース|201|10078|京都府芝ケ原古墳出土品}}。 * 長持形石棺 京都府城陽市久津川車塚古墳出土（考古資料） - 附指定は[[久津川車塚古墳]]参照。[[京都大学]]保管。1991年（平成3年）6月21日指定{{国指定文化財等データベース|201|10083|長持形石棺／京都府城陽市久津川車塚古墳出土}}。 === 国の史跡 === * 久津川古墳群 ** 久津川車塚古墳 ** 丸塚古墳 ** 芭蕉塚古墳 ** 久世小学校古墳 *: 1979年（昭和54年）1月19日、「久津川車塚・丸塚古墳」として国の史跡に指定。 *: 2016年（平成28年）10月3日、芭蕉塚古墳・久世小学校古墳の古墳2基を追加指定して、指定名称を「久津川古墳群」に変更{{国指定文化財等データベース|401|1741|久津川古墳群}}。 * 芝ヶ原古墳 *: 1989年（平成元年）9月6日指定。 *: 2012年（平成24年）1月24日に史跡範囲の追加指定{{国指定文化財等データベース|401|1750|芝ヶ原古墳}}。 === 城陽市指定文化財 === * 有形文化財 ** 芝ケ原11号墳出土品（考古資料） ファイル:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡
{{small|城陽市歴史民俗資料館（五里ごり館）展示。}} == アクセス == * [[近畿日本鉄道]] [[久津川駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。 * [[西日本旅客鉄道|JR]][[奈良線]] [[城陽駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。 == 脚注 == {{Reflist}} == 出典 == *[http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 城陽市 公式サイト 史跡　久津川車塚・丸塚古墳の紹介ページ] *[http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html 大和國古墳墓取調室 京都府城陽市の古墳] *[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 文化遺産オンライン 久津川車塚・丸塚古墳] *[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 京都府観光ガイド 城陽市 久津川古墳群] *[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm 城陽市の古墳] *[http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= 城陽市にある古墳] == 関連項目 == * [[近畿地方の史跡一覧]] == 外部リンク == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Group}} * {{国指定文化財等データベース|401|1741|久津川古墳群}} {{Japanese-history-stub}} {{DEFAULTSORT:くつかわこふんくん}} [[Category:久津川古墳群|*]] [[Category:古墳群]] [[Category:京都府の古墳]] [[Category:城陽市の歴史]] [[Category:京都府にある国指定の史跡]]

{{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=久津川
古墳群|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{Center|久津川古墳群の位置}}}} '''久津川古墳群'''（くつかわこふんぐん）は、[[京都府]][[城陽市]]にある[[古墳群]]。一部が国の[[史跡]]に指定されている。京都府内では最大級の古墳群である[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm 城陽市の古墳]。 == 概要 == [[近畿日本鉄道]][[久津川駅]]東側を流れる大谷川（おおたにがわ）周辺の平地部、丘陵部に位置する古墳群を指す。狭義には[[久津川車塚古墳]]周辺の10基前後の古墳を指す事もあるが、周辺丘陵部に点在する比較的小規模な古墳や古墳群を含めると、総計150基前後になるとされる[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 京都府観光ガイド 城陽市 久津川古墳群]。近年の宅地開発により、失われた物や、見えなくなっている物も少なくない[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 文化遺産オンライン 久津川車塚・丸塚古墳]。 従来、[[久津川車塚古墳]]と[[丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|丸塚古墳]]の2基が「久津川車塚・丸塚古墳」の呼称で国の[[史跡]]に指定されていたが、[[2016年]]（[[平成]]28年）に[[芭蕉塚古墳]]と[[久世小学校古墳]]が追加指定され、4基を総称する「久津川古墳群」の名称に変更された{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf 「史跡等の指定等について」]}}（文化庁記者発表、2016年6月17日）。平成28年10月3日文部科学省告示第144号。。またこれとは別に、芝ヶ原12号墳が「[[芝ヶ原古墳]]」の名称で国の史跡に指定されている。 == 主な古墳 == *[[久津川車塚古墳]] - 国の[[史跡]]。久津川古墳群の中だけでなく[[山城国|山城]]地域周辺では最大級の[[前方後円墳]]で、竜山石製の[[長持形石棺]]が発見された。 *[[丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|丸塚古墳]] - 国の史跡。[[帆立貝形古墳]]。 *[[青塚古墳 (城陽市)|青塚古墳]] - [[前方後方墳]]。 *[[赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|赤塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[平川廃寺跡]]に隣接。 *[[芭蕉塚古墳]] - 国の史跡。[[前方後円墳]]。 *[[梶塚古墳]] - [[方墳]]。久津川車塚古墳と敷地が一部重なる。 *[[指月塚古墳]] - [[円墳]]。[[城陽市立久津川小学校]]の敷地内に位置する場所にかつて存在し、現在は建物の下敷きとなり失われている。 *[[箱塚古墳 (城陽市)|箱塚古墳]] - [[前方後円墳]]。 *[[山道古墳 (城陽市)|山道古墳]] - [[方墳]]。現在は住宅地となり失われている。 *[[芝ヶ原古墳群]] - 大小13基から成る古墳群。芝ヶ原12号墳は「[[芝ヶ原古墳]]」として国の史跡に指定されている（史跡「久津川古墳群」には含まれない）。また[[城陽市立久世小学校]]の中庭部分に保存されている芝ヶ原9号墳は「[[久世小学校古墳]]」として国の史跡に指定された。 *[[尼塚古墳群 (城陽市)|尼塚古墳群]] - 大小7基から成る古墳群。尼塚1号墳～5号墳は住宅地となり失われ、6、7号墳は保存されている。 *[[上大谷古墳群]] - 大小20基から成る古墳群。11基が保存されている。 *[[下大谷古墳群]] - 大小2基から成る古墳群。2号墳は住宅地となり失われ、1号墳は保存されている。 *[[西山古墳群 (城陽市)|西山古墳群]] - 下大谷古墳群の近くにかつて存在したが、住宅地開発により全て失われた。 *[[大竹古墳 (城陽市)|大竹古墳]] - [[方墳]]。 *[[庵寺山古墳]] - 円墳 == その他の遺跡等 == *[[平川廃寺跡]] - 国の史跡。[[赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|赤塚古墳]]に隣接。 *[[久世廃寺跡]] - 国の史跡。 *[[正道官衙遺跡]] - 国の史跡。 == 文化財 == === 重要文化財（国指定） === * 山城国久世郡久津川車塚古墳出土鏡 7面（考古資料） - 内訳は[[久津川車塚古墳]]参照。[[泉屋博古館]]保管。1953年（昭和28年）11月14日指定{{国指定文化財等データベース|201|9721|山城国久世郡久津川車塚古墳出土鏡}}。 * 京都府芝ケ原古墳出土品 一括（考古資料） - 内訳は[[芝ヶ原古墳]]参照。城陽市歴史民俗資料館保管。1990年（平成2年）6月29日指定{{国指定文化財等データベース|201|10078|京都府芝ケ原古墳出土品}}。 * 長持形石棺 京都府城陽市久津川車塚古墳出土（考古資料） - 附指定は[[久津川車塚古墳]]参照。[[京都大学]]保管。1991年（平成3年）6月21日指定{{国指定文化財等データベース|201|10083|長持形石棺／京都府城陽市久津川車塚古墳出土}}。 === 国の史跡 === * 久津川古墳群 ** 久津川車塚古墳 ** 丸塚古墳 ** 芭蕉塚古墳 ** 久世小学校古墳 *: 1979年（昭和54年）1月19日、「久津川車塚・丸塚古墳」として国の史跡に指定。 *: 2016年（平成28年）10月3日、芭蕉塚古墳・久世小学校古墳の古墳2基を追加指定して、指定名称を「久津川古墳群」に変更{{国指定文化財等データベース|401|1741|久津川古墳群}}。 * 芝ヶ原古墳 *: 1989年（平成元年）9月6日指定。 *: 2012年（平成24年）1月24日に史跡範囲の追加指定{{国指定文化財等データベース|401|1750|芝ヶ原古墳}}。 === 城陽市指定文化財 === * 有形文化財 ** 芝ケ原11号墳出土品（考古資料） ファイル:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡
{{small|城陽市歴史民俗資料館（五里ごり館）展示。}} == アクセス == * [[近畿日本鉄道]] [[久津川駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。 * [[西日本旅客鉄道|JR]][[奈良線]] [[城陽駅]]から徒歩約10分～45分程度の圏内。 == 脚注 == {{Reflist}} == 出典 == *[http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 城陽市 公式サイト 史跡　久津川車塚・丸塚古墳の紹介ページ] *[http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html 大和國古墳墓取調室 京都府城陽市の古墳] *[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 文化遺産オンライン 久津川車塚・丸塚古墳] *[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 京都府観光ガイド 城陽市 久津川古墳群] *[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm 城陽市の古墳] *[http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= 城陽市にある古墳] == 関連項目 == * [[近畿地方の史跡一覧]] == 外部リンク == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Group}} * {{国指定文化財等データベース|401|1741|久津川古墳群}} {{Japanese-history-stub}} {{DEFAULTSORT:くつかわこふんくん}} [[Category:久津川古墳群|*]] [[Category:古墳群]] [[Category:京都府の古墳]] [[Category:城陽市の歴史]] [[Category:京都府にある国指定の史跡]]

{{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Cluster|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of [[kofun]] Kofuns located in {{ill|Joyo|ja|城陽市}}, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of Kofuns is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺|1=Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * **{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * **{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - Rectangular front and rear Kofun. * **{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)}}** - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳}} adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}. * **{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳}}** - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Kajizuka Kofun** - Square Kofun partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * **Shigetsuzuka Kofun** - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳}} previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校}} but now lost due to construction. * **Hakozuka Kofun** - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Yamamichi Kofun** - Square Kofun lost due to residential development. * **{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群}}** - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳}}," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳}}." * **{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群}}** - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * **Kami-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * **Shimo-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * **{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)}}** - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * **Otakeshi Kofun** - Square Kofun. * **{{ill|Anjiyama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳}}** - Round Kofun. == Other Sites == * **{{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * **{{ill|Kuse Temple Ruins|ja|久世廃寺跡}}** - National Historic Site. * **{{ill|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins|ja|正道官衙遺跡}}** - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * **Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at {{ill|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum|ja|泉屋博古館}}. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * **Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|burial goods Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * **Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * **Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster** ** Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ** Marutsuka Kofun ** Basho-zuka Kofun ** Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * **Shibagahara Kofun** *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * **Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun
{{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道}} Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|JR West Nara Line|ja|奈良線}} Joyo Station. == References == {{Reflist}} == Sources == * [http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 Official Page on Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html Ancient Kofuns of Joyo City] * [https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] * [http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] * [http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= List of Kofun in Joyo City] == See Also == * [[List of Historic Sites in the Kinki Region]] == External Links == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Group}} * {{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} {{draft categories| }} {{citation needed|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} {{Kofun navbar}} {{draft categories| [[Category:Kofun template and pages that transclude it]] [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster|*]] [[Category:Kofun Clusters]] [[Category:Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:History of Joyo City]] [[Category:National Historic Sites in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:Completion tier 4]] [[Category:11]] [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[Category:null edit to force updates]] [[Category:Fixed Kofun templates]] }} [[sn:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[ja:久津川古墳群]] {{translated page|ja|久津川古墳群|version=100529817|comment=Imported full ja history}}

Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道|12=draft}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|12=draft}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of Kofuns is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|12=draft}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|12=draft}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|12=draft}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|12=draft}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳|12=draft}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A scallop-shaped kofun. * **{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)|12=draft}}** - Rectangular front and rear Kofun. * **{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|12=draft}}** - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|12=draft}} adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡|12=draft}}. * **{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|12=draft}}** - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Kajizuka Kofun** - Square Kofun partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * **Shigetsuzuka Kofun** - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|12=draft}} previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校|12=draft}} but now lost due to construction. * **Hakozuka Kofun** - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Yamamichi Kofun** - Square Kofun lost due to residential development. * **{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群|12=draft}}** - A group of 13 kofun. {{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Cluster|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of [[kofun]] Kofuns located in {{ill|Joyo|ja|城陽市|qq=draft}}, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道|qq=draft}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of Kofuns is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳|qq=draft}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft}}** - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺|1=Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=draft}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * **{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft}}** - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * **{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft}}** - Rectangular front and rear Kofun. * **{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft}}** - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|qq=draft}} adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡|qq=draft}}. * **{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft}}** - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Kajizuka Kofun** - Square Kofun partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * **Shigetsuzuka Kofun** - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|qq=draft}} previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校|qq=draft}} but now lost due to construction. * **Hakozuka Kofun** - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Yamamichi Kofun** - Square Kofun lost due to residential development. * **{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群|qq=draft}}** - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳|qq=draft}}," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校|qq=draft}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft}}." * **{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群|qq=draft}}** - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * **Kami-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * **Shimo-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * **{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)|qq=draft}}** - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * **Otakeshi Kofun** - Square Kofun. * **{{ill|Anjiyama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳|qq=draft}}** - Round Kofun. == Other Sites == * **{{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡|qq=draft}}** - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * **{{ill|Kuse Temple Ruins|ja|久世廃寺跡|qq=draft}}** - National Historic Site. * **{{ill|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins|ja|正道官衙遺跡|qq=draft}}** - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * **Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at {{ill|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum|ja|泉屋博古館|qq=draft}}. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * **Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|burial goods Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * **Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * **Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster** ** Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ** Marutsuka Kofun ** Basho-zuka Kofun ** Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * **Shibagahara Kofun** *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * **Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun
{{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道|qq=draft}} Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|JR West Nara Line|ja|奈良線|qq=draft}} Joyo Station. == References == {{Reflist}} == Sources == * [http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 Official Page on Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html Ancient Kofuns of Joyo City] * [https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] * [http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] * [http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= List of Kofun in Joyo City] == See Also == * [[List of Historic Sites in the Kinki Region]] == External Links == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Group}} * {{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} {{Kofun navbar}} {{translated page|ja|久津川古墳群|version=100529817|comment=Imported full ja history}} {{draft categories| [[Category:Kofun template and pages that transclude it]] [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster|*]] [[Category:Kofun Clusters]] [[Category:Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:History of Joyo City]] [[Category:National Historic Sites in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:Completion tier 4]] [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[Category:null edit to force updates]] [[Category:Fixed Kofun templates]] }} [[sn:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[ja:久津川古墳群]]

Kofun Group|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{Center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Group}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Group''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of ancient Kofuns ([[kofun]]) located in {{ill|Jōyō City|ja|城陽市|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jōyō City|qq=}}, {{ill|Kyoto Prefecture|ja|京都府|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyoto Prefecture|qq=}}, Japan. Parts of the group have been designated as a {{ill|Historic Site of Japan|ja|史跡|1=Historic site|lt=Historic site of Japan|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Historic Site of Japan|13=User:Immanuelle/Historic site|qq=}}}. It is among the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Ancient Kofuns of Jōyō City] == Overview == The Kofun Group is located in the plains and hills near the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kutsukawa Station|ja|久津川駅|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Station|qq=}}, operated by {{ill|Kintetsu Railway|ja|近畿日本鉄道|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kintetsu Railway|qq=}}. Narrowly, it refers to about ten mounds near the {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}, but the broader area, including smaller kofun in surrounding hills, comprises approximately 150 mounds.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide - Kutsukawa Kofun Group] Due to residential development, some mounds have been lost or are no longer visible.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online - Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Maruzuka Kofun] Originally, the {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} and the {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} were designated as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Maruzuka Kofun" as a Historic Site of Japan. In 2016 (Heisei 28), the {{ill|Bashōzuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} and the {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuse Elementary School Kofun|qq=}} were added to the designation, and the collective name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Group."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodoha11yo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Announcement of Historic Site Designation Changes]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, the {{ill|Shibahara 12 Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibahara 12 Kofun|qq=}} has also been designated as a Historic Site of Japan under the name "Shibahara Kofun." == Main Kofun == * {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} - A {{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Keyhole-shaped kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Zenpokoenfun|qq=}}, the largest in the {{ill|Yamashiro Province|ja|Yamashiro Province|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamashiro Province|qq=}} region, featuring a stone burial chest made from Tatsuyama stone. * {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} - A {{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後方墳|1=zenpō-kōhō-fun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Keyhole-shaped kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/zenpō-kōhō-fun|qq=}}. * {{ill|Akazuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|赤塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Akazuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} - A {{ill|Circular Kofun|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Circular Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=}} adjacent to the {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hirakawa Temple Ruins|qq=}}. * {{ill|Bashōzuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} - A {{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Keyhole-shaped kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Zenpokoenfun|qq=}} and part of the National Historic Site designation. * {{ill|Kajizuka Kofun|ja|梶塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kajizuka Kofun|qq=}} - Parts of the site are designated as a {{ill|National Historic Site of Japan|ja|史跡|1=Historic site|lt=Historic site of Japan|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/National Historic Site of Japan|13=User:Immanuelle/Historic site|qq=}}}. It is one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun in Jōyō City] == Overview == The kofun group is situated on flatlands and hills around the {{ill|Ōtanigawa River|ja|大谷川|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtanigawa River|qq=}} near {{ill|Kintetsu Kutsukawa Station|ja|近鉄久津川駅|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kintetsu Kutsukawa Station|qq=}}. In a narrow sense, it refers to around 10 kofun near the {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered across surrounding hills, the total is estimated to be around 150 mounds.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379 Kyoto Tourism Guide - Kutsukawa Kofun Group] Due to recent residential development, many kofun have been lost or are no longer visible.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online - Kutsukawa Kurazuka & Marutsuka Kofun] Originally, two kofun—{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Marutsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Marutsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}}—were designated as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In {{ill|2016|ja|2016th year|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/2016|qq=}} (Heisei 28), {{ill|Bashōzuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Kuze Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuze Elementary School Kofun|qq=}} were added, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Group." {{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding the Designation of Historic Sites, etc.]}} (Cultural Agency Press Release, June 17, 2016).MEXT Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, the {{ill|Shibagahara 12th Mound|ja|芝ヶ原12号墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibagahara 12th Mound|qq=}} is designated as the National Historic Site "Shibagahara Kofun." == Main Kofun == * {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} - National Historic Site. The largest {{ill|zenpō-kōen-fun (keyhole-shaped mound)|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/zenpō-kōen-fun (keyhole-shaped mound)|13=User:Immanuelle/Zenpokoenfun|qq=}} in the Yamashiro region, where a {{ill|nagabuchi-style stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺|1=Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/nagabuchi-style stone coffin|13=User:Immanuelle/Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=}} made of Tatsuyama stone was discovered. * {{ill|Marutsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Marutsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} - National Historic Site. A {{ill|scallop-shaped kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/scallop-shaped kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop Kofun|qq=}}. * {{ill|Aotsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Aotsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} - {{ill|zenpō-kōhō-fun (front-square, rear-rounded mound)|ja|前方後方墳|1=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/zenpō-kōhō-fun (front-square, rear-rounded mound)|13=User:Immanuelle/Zenpō-kōhō-fun|qq=}}. * {{ill|Akatsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Akatsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} - {{ill|circular kofun (empun)|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/circular kofun (empun)|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=}}, adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hirakawa Temple Ruins|qq=}}. * {{ill|Bashōzuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} - National Historic Site. Kofun Cluster|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of [[kofun]] Kofuns located in {{ill|Joyo|ja|城陽市|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Joyo|qq=}}, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kintetsu|qq=}}'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of Kofuns is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|qq=}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Basho-zuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuse Elementary School Kofun|qq=}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibagahara Kofun|qq=}}" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * **{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}** - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺|1=Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nagashigata stone coffin|13=User:Immanuelle/Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * **{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|qq=}}** - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * **{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Aotsuka Kofun|qq=}}** - Rectangular front and rear Kofun. * **{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Akatsuka Kofun|qq=}}** - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=}} adjacent to {{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hirakawa Temple Ruins|qq=}}. * **{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Basho-zuka Kofun|qq=}}** - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Kajizuka Kofun** - Square Kofun partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * **Shigetsuzuka Kofun** - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=}} previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|qq=}} but now lost due to construction. * **Hakozuka Kofun** - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * **Yamamichi Kofun** - Square Kofun lost due to residential development. * **{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibagahara Kofun Group|qq=}}** - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibagahara Kofun|qq=}}," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|qq=}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuse Elementary School Kofun|qq=}}." * **{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nitsuka Kofun Group|qq=}}** - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * **Kami-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * **Shimo-Otani Kofun Group** - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * **{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nishiyama Kofun Group|qq=}}** - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * **Otakeshi Kofun** - Square Kofun. * **{{ill|Anjiyama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Anjiyama Kofun|qq=}}** - Round Kofun. == Other Sites == * **{{ill|Hirakawa Temple Ruins|ja|平川廃寺跡|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hirakawa Temple Ruins|qq=}}** - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * **{{ill|Kuse Temple Ruins|ja|久世廃寺跡|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuse Temple Ruins|qq=}}** - National Historic Site. * **{{ill|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins|ja|正道官衙遺跡|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seido Administrative Complex Ruins|qq=}}** - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * **Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at {{ill|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum|ja|泉屋博古館|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum|qq=}}. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * **Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|burial goods Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * **Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * **Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster** ** Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ** Marutsuka Kofun ** Basho-zuka Kofun ** Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * **Shibagahara Kofun** *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * **Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)** File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun
{{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kintetsu|ja|近畿日本鉄道|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kintetsu|qq=}} Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|JR West Nara Line|ja|奈良線|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/JR West Nara Line|qq=}} Joyo Station. == References == {{Reflist}} == Sources == * [http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 Official Page on Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html Ancient Kofuns of Joyo City] * [https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] * [http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] * [http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= List of Kofun in Joyo City] == See Also == * [[List of Historic Sites in the Kinki Region]] == External Links == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Group}} * {{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} {{Kofun navbar}} {{translated page|ja|久津川古墳群|version=100529817|comment=Imported full ja history}} {{draft categories| [[Category:Kofun template and pages that transclude it]] [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster|*]] [[Category:Kofun Clusters]] [[Category:Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:History of Joyo City]] [[Category:National Historic Sites in Kyoto Prefecture]] [[Category:Completion tier 4]] [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[Category:null edit to force updates]] [[Category:Fixed Kofun templates]] }} [[sn:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[ja:久津川古墳群]]
