{{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Group|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{Center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of ancient Kofuns ([[kofun]]) located in [[:en:Jōyō, Kyoto|Jōyō City]], [[:en:Kyoto Prefecture|Kyoto Prefecture]], Japan. Parts of the group have been designated as a [[:en:Historic site|Historic site of Japan]]}. It is among the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Ancient Kofuns of Jōyō City] == Overview == The Kofun Group is located in the plains and hills near the Otanigawa River, east of [[:en:Kutsukawa Station|Kutsukawa Station]], operated by [[:en:Kintetsu Railway|Kintetsu Railway]]. Narrowly, it refers to about ten mounds near the {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}, but the broader area, including smaller kofun in surrounding hills, comprises approximately 150 mounds.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide - Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Due to residential development, some mounds have been lost or are no longer visible.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online - Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Maruzuka Kofun] Originally, the {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} and the {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|lt=Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|lt=Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} were designated as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Maruzuka Kofun" as a Historic Site of Japan. In 2016 (Heisei 28), the {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} and the {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuse Elementary School Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 城陽市立久世小学校}} were added to the designation, and the collective name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodoha11yo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Announcement of Historic Site Designation Changes]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, the [[:en:Shibagahara Kofun|Shibagahara Kofun]] has also been designated as a Historic Site of Japan under the name "Shibahara Kofun." == Main Kofun == * {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} - A [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]], the largest in the {{ill|Yamashiro Province|ja|Yamashiro Province|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamashiro Province|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} region, featuring a stone burial chest made from Tatsuyama stone. * {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|lt=Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|lt=Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} - A {{ill|Scallop-shaped kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop-shaped kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}. * {{ill|Aozuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|青塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Aozuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} - A {{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後方墳|lt=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|1=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|comment=doing this because I need to differentiate it in piped links too with my new interwiki tool as not the ambiguous phrase keyhole shaped kofun|1=zenpō-kōhō-fun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Keyhole-shaped kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/zenpō-kōhō-fun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}. * {{ill|Akazuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|赤塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Akazuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 川部・高森古墳群}} - A {{ill|Circular Kofun|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Circular Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} adjacent to the [[:en:Hirakawa temple ruins|Hirakawa Temple Ruins]]. * {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} - A [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] and part of the National Historic Site designation. * {{ill|Kajizuka Kofun|ja|梶塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kajizuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - A {{ill|Square Kofun|ja|方墳|1=Square Kofun|1=Square Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Square Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Square Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, partially overla11ing with the Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun site. * {{ill|Shibahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibahara Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 芝ヶ原古墳}} - Comprising 13 mounds, with the 12th mound designated as the "Shibahara Kofun" National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * Mirrors excavated from the Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 items) - Preserved at the [[:en:Sen-oku Hakuko Kan|Iizuka Antiquities Museum]]. Designated in 1953 (Showa 28).{{National Cultural Properties Database|201|9721|Mirrors from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === Historic Sites of Japan === * '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' ''' Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ''' Maruzuka Kofun ''' Bashōzuka Kofun ''' Kuse Elementary School Kofun * '''Shibahara Kofun''' == Access == * A11roximately 10–45 minutes' walk from [[:en:Kutsukawa Station|Kutsukawa Station]] on the [[:en:Kyoto Line (Kintetsu)|Kintetsu Kyoto Line]]. * A11roximately 10–45 minutes' walk from [[:en:Jōyō Station|Jōyō Station]] on the [[:en:Nara Line (JR West)|JR Nara Line]]. == References == {{Reflist}} == See Also == * {{ill|List of Historic Sites of the Kinki Region|ja|近畿地方の史跡一覧|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Historic Sites of the Kinki Region|qq=}} == External Links == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * {{National Cultural Properties Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} The '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of {{ill|kofun|ja|古墳群|1=Kofun cluster|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kofun cluster|qq=}} (ancient Kofuns) located in [[:en:Jōyō, Kyoto|Jōyō, Kyoto]], [[:en:Kyoto Prefecture|Kyoto Prefecture]]. Parts of the site are designated as a [[:en:Historic site|Historic site of Japan]]}. It is one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun in Jōyō City] == Overview == The kofun group is situated on flatlands and hills around the {{ill|Ōtanigawa River|ja|大谷川|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtanigawa River|qq=}} near {{ill|Kintetsu Kutsukawa Station|ja|近鉄久津川駅|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kintetsu Kutsukawa Station|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. In a narrow sense, it refers to around 10 kofun near the {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered across surrounding hills, the total is estimated to be around 150 mounds.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379 Kyoto Tourism Guide - Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Due to recent residential development, many kofun have been lost or are no longer visible.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online - Kutsukawa Kurazuka & Marutsuka Kofun] Originally, two kofun—{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Marutsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Marutsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}}—were designated as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In [[:en:2016|2016]] (Heisei 28), {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Kuze Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuze Elementary School Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 城陽市立久世小学校}} were added, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." {{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding the Designation of Historic Sites, etc.]}} (Cultural Agency Press Release, June 17, 2016).MEXT Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, the {{ill|Shibagahara 12th Mound|ja|芝ヶ原12号墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibagahara 12th Mound|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} is designated as the National Historic Site "Shibagahara Kofun." == Main Kofun == * {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} - National Historic Site. The largest [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] in the Yamashiro region, where a {{ill|nagabuchi-style stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺|1=Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/nagabuchi-style stone coffin|13=User:Immanuelle/Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=}} made of Tatsuyama stone was discovered. * {{ill|Marutsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Marutsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} - National Historic Site. A {{ill|scallop-shaped kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/scallop-shaped kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}. * {{ill|Aotsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Aotsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - {{ill|zenpō-kōhō-fun (front-square, rear-rounded mound)|ja|前方後方墳|lt=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|1=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|comment=doing this because I need to differentiate it in piped links too with my new interwiki tool as not the ambiguous phrase keyhole shaped kofun|1=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/zenpō-kōhō-fun (front-square, rear-rounded mound)|13=User:Immanuelle/Zenpō-kōhō-fun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}. * {{ill|Akatsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Akatsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - {{ill|circular kofun (empun)|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/circular kofun (empun)|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, adjacent to [[:en:Hirakawa temple ruins|Hirakawa Temple Ruins]]. * {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * {{ill|Kajitsuka Kofun|ja|梶塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kajitsuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - {{ill|square kofun (hōfun)|ja|方墳|1=Square Kofun|1=Square Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/square kofun (hōfun)|13=User:Immanuelle/Square Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, partially overlapping with Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * {{ill|Shigetsuzuka Kofun|ja|指月塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shigetsuzuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Circular kofun, formerly located on the grounds of {{ill|Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Elementary School|qq=}}; now lost due to construction. * {{ill|Hakotsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|箱塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hakotsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * {{ill|Yamamichi Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|山道古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamamichi Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Square kofun, now lost to residential development. * {{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibagahara Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 芝ヶ原古墳}} - Comprises 13 kofun. Shibagahara 12th Mound is designated as a National Historic Site, separate from the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster. Shibagahara 9th Mound is preserved as Kuze Elementary School Kofun. * {{ill|Amatsuka Kofun Group (Jōyō)|ja|尼塚古墳群 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Amatsuka Kofun Group (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Comprises 7 kofun. Mounds 1–5 are lost, while 6 and 7 are preserved. * {{ill|Kami Ōtani Kofun Group|ja|上大谷古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kami Ōtani Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Comprises 20 kofun, with dd preserved. * {{ill|Shimo Ōtani Kofun Group|ja|下大谷古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shimo Ōtani Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Comprises 2 kofun; Mound 2 is lost, Mound 1 preserved. * {{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group (Jōyō)|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nishiyama Kofun Group (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Previously near Shimo Ōtani Kofun Group, but all lost due to development. * {{ill|Ōtake Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|大竹古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtake Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Square kofun. * {{ill|Anderayama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Anjiyama Kofun|qq=}} - Circular kofun. == Other Historical Sites == * [[:en:Hirakawa temple ruins|Hirakawa Temple Ruins]] - National Historic Site, adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * [[:en:Kuse temple ruins|Kuze Temple Ruins]] - National Historic Site. * [[:en:Shōdō Kanga ruins|Shōdō Kanga Ruins]] - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * '''Bronze Mirrors from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun''' (7 pieces) - Stored at [[:en:Sen-oku Hakuko Kan|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum]], designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Properties Database|201|9721|Bronze Mirrors from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * '''Artifacts from Shibagahara Kofun''' - Stored at Jōyō City Museum of History and Folklore, designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Properties Database|201|10078|burial goods from Shibagahara Kofun}} * '''Nagabuchi-Style Stone Coffin from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun''' - Stored at [[:en:Kyoto University|Kyoto University]], designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Properties Database|201|10083|Nagabuchi-Style Stone Coffin}} === National Historic Sites === * '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' ''' Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ''' Marutsuka Kofun ''' Bashōzuka Kofun ''' Kuze Elementary School Kofun Designated as a National Historic Site on January 19, 1979, and renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" in 2016 with the addition of Bashōzuka Kofun and Kuze Elementary School Kofun.{{National Cultural Properties Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * '''Shibagahara Kofun''' - Designated on September 6, 1989, with expanded boundaries designated on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Properties Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Jōyō City Designated Cultural Properties === * '''Artifacts from Shibagahara ddth Mound''' File:Shibagahara ddth Mound Mirror.JPG|Triangular-Rimmed Mirror with Three Deities and Four Beasts, from Shibagahara ddth Mound
{{small|Displayed at Jōyō City Museum of History and Folklore.}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kintetsu Kutsukawa Station|ja|近鉄久津川駅|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kintetsu Kutsukawa Station|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|JR Nara Line Jōyō Station|ja|奈良線 城陽駅|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/JR Nara Line Jōyō Station|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Articles == * {{ill|List of Historic Sites of Japan (Kinki)|ja|近畿地方の史跡一覧|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Historic Sites of Japan (Kinki)|qq=}} == External Links == * {{National Cultural Properties Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} {{translated page|ja|久津川古墳群|version=100529817|comment=Imported full ja history}} {{draft categories| [[Category:Completion tier 4]] }} [[sn:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[ja:久津川古墳群]] [[sn:utsukawa Kofun Group]] [[en:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[sn:uzugawa Kofuns]] [[sn:Kuzugawa Kofuns]] {{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Cluster|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of [[kofun]] Kofuns located in [[:en:Jōyō, Kyoto|Joyo]], Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of [[:en:Kintetsu Railway|Kintetsu]]'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of Kofuns is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|qq=}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Basho-zuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuse Elementary School Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 城陽市立久世小学校}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "[[:en:Shibagahara Kofun|Shibagahara Kofun]]" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * '''{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}''' - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺|1=Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nagashigata stone coffin|13=User:Immanuelle/Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * '''{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|qq=}}''' - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * '''{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Aotsuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''' - Rectangular front and rear Kofun. * '''{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Akatsuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''' - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} adjacent to [[:en:Hirakawa temple ruins|Hirakawa Temple Ruins]]. * '''{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Basho-zuka Kofun|qq=}}''' - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * '''Kajizuka Kofun''' - Square Kofun partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * '''Shigetsuzuka Kofun''' - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|qq=}} but now lost due to construction. * '''Hakozuka Kofun''' - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * '''Yamamichi Kofun''' - Square Kofun lost due to residential development. * '''{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibagahara Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 芝ヶ原古墳}}''' - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "[[:en:Shibagahara Kofun|Shibagahara Kofun]]," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|qq=}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuse Elementary School Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 城陽市立久世小学校}}." * '''{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nitsuka Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''' - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * '''Kami-Otani Kofun Group''' - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * '''Shimo-Otani Kofun Group''' - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * '''{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nishiyama Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''' - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * '''Otakeshi Kofun''' - Square Kofun. * '''{{ill|Anderayama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Anjiyama Kofun|qq=}}''' - Round Kofun. == Other Sites == * '''[[:en:Hirakawa temple ruins|Hirakawa Temple Ruins]]''' - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * '''[[:en:Kuse temple ruins|Kuse Temple Ruins]]''' - National Historic Site. * '''[[:en:Shōdō Kanga ruins|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins]]''' - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * '''Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)''' - Stored at [[:en:Sen-oku Hakuko Kan|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum]]. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * '''Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)''' - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|burial goods Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * '''Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)''' - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' ''' Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ''' Marutsuka Kofun ''' Basho-zuka Kofun ''' Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * '''Shibagahara Kofun''' *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * '''Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)''' File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun
{{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from [[:en:Kintetsu Railway|Kintetsu]] Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from [[:en:Nara Line (JR West)|JR West Nara Line]] Joyo Station. == References == {{Reflist}} == Sources == * [http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 Official Page on Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html Ancient Kofuns of Joyo City] * [https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] * [http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] * [http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= List of Kofun in Joyo City] == See Also == * [[List of Historic Sites in the Kinki Region]] == External Links == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * {{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} {{Kofun navbar}} {{translated page|ja|久津川古墳群|version=100529817|comment=Imported full ja history}} {{draft categories| [[Category:Completion tier 4]] [[sn:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] }} [[sn:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[ja:久津川古墳群]] [[Category:Kuzugawa Kofun Group]] [[Category:Kofun of Kyoto prefecture]] [[Category:History of Joyo, Kyoto]] {{Commons category|Kutsukawa Kofun Group}} [[Category:translated pages with valid en interwikis]]

{{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Group|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{Center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of ancient Kofuns ([[kofun]]) located in [[:en:Jōyō, Kyoto|Jōyō City]], [[:en:Kyoto Prefecture|Kyoto Prefecture]], Japan. Parts of the group have been designated as a [[:en:Historic site|Historic site of Japan]]}. It is among the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Ancient Kofuns of Jōyō City] == Overview == The Kofun Group is located in the plains and hills near the Otanigawa River, east of [[:en:Kutsukawa Station|Kutsukawa Station]], operated by [[:en:Kintetsu Railway|Kintetsu Railway]]. Narrowly, it refers to about ten mounds near the {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}, but the broader area, including smaller kofun in surrounding hills, comprises approximately 150 mounds.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide - Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Due to residential development, some mounds have been lost or are no longer visible.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online - Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Maruzuka Kofun] Originally, the {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} and the {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|lt=Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|lt=Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} were designated as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Maruzuka Kofun" as a Historic Site of Japan. In 2016 (Heisei 28), the {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} and the {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuse Elementary School Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 城陽市立久世小学校}} were added to the designation, and the collective name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodoha11yo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Announcement of Historic Site Designation Changes]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of [[:en:Kintetsu Railway|Kintetsu]]'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of Kofuns is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|qq=}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Basho-zuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuse Elementary School Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 城陽市立久世小学校}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "[[:en:Shibagahara Kofun|Shibagahara Kofun]]" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * '''{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}''' - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * '''{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Aotsuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''' - Rectangular front and rear Kofun. * '''{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Akatsuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''' - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} adjacent to [[:en:Hirakawa temple ruins|Hirakawa Temple Ruins]]. * '''{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Basho-zuka Kofun|qq=}}''' - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * '''Kajizuka Kofun''' - Square Kofun partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * '''Shigetsuzuka Kofun''' - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|qq=}} but now lost due to construction. * '''Hakozuka Kofun''' - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * '''Yamamichi Kofun''' - Square Kofun lost due to residential development. * '''{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibagahara Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 芝ヶ原古墳}}''' - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "[[:en:Shibagahara Kofun|Shibagahara Kofun]]," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|qq=}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuse Elementary School Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 城陽市立久世小学校}}." * '''{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nitsuka Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''' - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * '''Kami-Otani Kofun Group''' - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * '''Shimo-Otani Kofun Group''' - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * '''{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nishiyama Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''' - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * '''Otakeshi Kofun''' - Square Kofun. * '''{{ill|Anderayama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Anjiyama Kofun|qq=}}''' - Round Kofun. == Other Sites == * '''[[:en:Hirakawa temple ruins|Hirakawa Temple Ruins]]''' - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * '''[[:en:Kuse temple ruins|Kuse Temple Ruins]]''' - National Historic Site. * '''[[:en:Shōdō Kanga ruins|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins]]''' - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * '''Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)''' - Stored at [[:en:Sen-oku Hakuko Kan|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum]]. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * '''Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)''' - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|burial goods Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * '''Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)''' - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' ''' Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ''' Marutsuka Kofun ''' Basho-zuka Kofun ''' Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * '''Shibagahara Kofun''' *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * '''Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)''' File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun
{{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from [[:en:Kintetsu Railway|Kintetsu]] Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from [[:en:Nara Line (JR West)|JR West Nara Line]] Joyo Station. == References == {{Reflist}} == Sources == * [http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 Official Page on Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html Ancient Kofuns of Joyo City] * [https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] * [http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] * [http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= List of Kofun in Joyo City] == See Also == * [[List of Historic Sites in the Kinki Region]] == External Links == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * {{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} {{Kofun navbar}} {{translated page|ja|久津川古墳群|version=100529817|comment=Imported full ja history}} {{draft categories| [[Category:Completion tier 4]] [[sn:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] }} [[sn:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[ja:久津川古墳群]] [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[Category:Kofun of Kyoto prefecture]] [[Category:History of Joyo, Kyoto]] {{Commons category|Kutsukawa Kofun Group}} [[Category:translated pages with valid en interwikis]]

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q22118592]] Wikidata name: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:47, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Group|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{Center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of ancient Kofuns ([[kofun]]) located in [[:en:Jōyō, Kyoto|Jōyō City]], [[:en:Kyoto Prefecture|Kyoto Prefecture]], Japan. Parts of the group have been designated as a [[:en:Historic site|Historic site of Japan]]}. It is among the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Ancient Kofuns of Jōyō City] == Overview == The Kofun Group is located in the plains and hills near the Otanigawa River, east of [[:en:Kutsukawa Station|Kutsukawa Station]], operated by [[:en:Kintetsu Railway|Kintetsu Railway]]. Narrowly, it refers to about ten mounds near the {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}, but the broader area, including smaller kofun in surrounding hills, comprises approximately 150 mounds.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide - Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Due to residential development, some mounds have been lost or are no longer visible.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online - Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Maruzuka Kofun] Originally, the {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} and the {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|lt=Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|lt=Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} were designated as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Maruzuka Kofun" as a Historic Site of Japan. In 2016 (Heisei 28), the {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} and the {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuse Elementary School Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 城陽市立久世小学校}} were added to the designation, and the collective name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodoha11yo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Announcement of Historic Site Designation Changes]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, the [[:en:Shibagahara Kofun|Shibagahara Kofun]] has also been designated as a Historic Site of Japan under the name "Shibahara Kofun." == Main Kofun == * {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} - A [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]], the largest in the {{ill|Yamashiro Province|ja|Yamashiro Province|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamashiro Province|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} region, featuring a stone burial chest made from Tatsuyama stone. * {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|lt=Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|lt=Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} - A {{ill|Scallop-shaped kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop-shaped kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}. * {{ill|Aozuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|青塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Aozuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} - A {{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後方墳|lt=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|1=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|comment=doing this because I need to differentiate it in piped links too with my new interwiki tool as not the ambiguous phrase keyhole shaped kofun|1=zenpō-kōhō-fun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Keyhole-shaped kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/zenpō-kōhō-fun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}. * {{ill|Akazuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|赤塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Akazuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 川部・高森古墳群}} - A {{ill|Circular Kofun|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Circular Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} adjacent to the [[:en:Hirakawa temple ruins|Hirakawa Temple Ruins]]. * {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} - A [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] and part of the National Historic Site designation. * {{ill|Kajizuka Kofun|ja|梶塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kajizuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - A {{ill|Square Kofun|ja|方墳|1=Square Kofun|1=Square Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Square Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Square Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, partially overla11ing with the Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun site. * {{ill|Shibahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibahara Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 芝ヶ原古墳}} - Comprising 13 mounds, with the 12th mound designated as the "Shibahara Kofun" National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * Mirrors excavated from the Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 items) - Preserved at the [[:en:Sen-oku Hakuko Kan|Iizuka Antiquities Museum]]. Designated in 1953 (Showa 28).{{National Cultural Properties Database|201|9721|Mirrors from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === Historic Sites of Japan === * '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' ''' Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ''' Maruzuka Kofun ''' Bashōzuka Kofun ''' Kuse Elementary School Kofun * '''Shibahara Kofun''' == Access == * A11roximately 10–45 minutes' walk from [[:en:Kutsukawa Station|Kutsukawa Station]] on the [[:en:Kyoto Line (Kintetsu)|Kintetsu Kyoto Line]]. * A11roximately 10–45 minutes' walk from [[:en:Jōyō Station|Jōyō Station]] on the [[:en:Nara Line (JR West)|JR Nara Line]]. == References == {{Reflist}} == See Also == * {{ill|List of Historic Sites of the Kinki Region|ja|近畿地方の史跡一覧|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Historic Sites of the Kinki Region|qq=}} == External Links == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * {{National Cultural Properties Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} The '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of {{ill|kofun|ja|古墳群|1=Kofun cluster|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kofun cluster|qq=}} (ancient Kofuns) located in [[:en:Jōyō, Kyoto|Jōyō, Kyoto]], [[:en:Kyoto Prefecture|Kyoto Prefecture]]. Parts of the site are designated as a [[:en:Historic site|Historic site of Japan]]}. It is one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun in Jōyō City] == Overview == The kofun group is situated on flatlands and hills around the {{ill|Ōtanigawa River|ja|大谷川|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtanigawa River|qq=}} near {{ill|Kintetsu Kutsukawa Station|ja|近鉄久津川駅|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kintetsu Kutsukawa Station|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. In a narrow sense, it refers to around 10 kofun near the {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered across surrounding hills, the total is estimated to be around 150 mounds.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379 Kyoto Tourism Guide - Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Due to recent residential development, many kofun have been lost or are no longer visible.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online - Kutsukawa Kurazuka & Marutsuka Kofun] Originally, two kofun—{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Marutsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Marutsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}}—were designated as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In [[:en:2016|2016]] (Heisei 28), {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Kuze Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuze Elementary School Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 城陽市立久世小学校}} were added, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." {{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding the Designation of Historic Sites, etc.]}} (Cultural Agency Press Release, June 17, 2016).MEXT Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, the {{ill|Shibagahara 12th Mound|ja|芝ヶ原12号墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibagahara 12th Mound|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} is designated as the National Historic Site "Shibagahara Kofun." == Main Kofun == * {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} - National Historic Site. The largest [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] in the Yamashiro region, where a {{ill|nagabuchi-style stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺|1=Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/nagabuchi-style stone coffin|13=User:Immanuelle/Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=}} made of Tatsuyama stone was discovered. * {{ill|Marutsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Marutsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} - National Historic Site. A {{ill|scallop-shaped kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/scallop-shaped kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}. * {{ill|Aotsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Aotsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - {{ill|zenpō-kōhō-fun (front-square, rear-rounded mound)|ja|前方後方墳|lt=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|1=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|comment=doing this because I need to differentiate it in piped links too with my new interwiki tool as not the ambiguous phrase keyhole shaped kofun|1=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/zenpō-kōhō-fun (front-square, rear-rounded mound)|13=User:Immanuelle/Zenpō-kōhō-fun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}. * {{ill|Akatsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Akatsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - {{ill|circular kofun (empun)|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/circular kofun (empun)|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, adjacent to [[:en:Hirakawa temple ruins|Hirakawa Temple Ruins]]. * {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * {{ill|Kajitsuka Kofun|ja|梶塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kajitsuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - {{ill|square kofun (hōfun)|ja|方墳|1=Square Kofun|1=Square Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/square kofun (hōfun)|13=User:Immanuelle/Square Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, partially overlapping with Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * {{ill|Shigetsuzuka Kofun|ja|指月塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shigetsuzuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Circular kofun, formerly located on the grounds of {{ill|Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Elementary School|qq=}}; now lost due to construction. * {{ill|Hakotsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|箱塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hakotsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * {{ill|Yamamichi Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|山道古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamamichi Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Square kofun, now lost to residential development. * {{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibagahara Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 芝ヶ原古墳}} - Comprises 13 kofun. Shibagahara 12th Mound is designated as a National Historic Site, separate from the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster. Shibagahara 9th Mound is preserved as Kuze Elementary School Kofun. * {{ill|Amatsuka Kofun Group (Jōyō)|ja|尼塚古墳群 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Amatsuka Kofun Group (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Comprises 7 kofun. Mounds 1–5 are lost, while 6 and 7 are preserved. * {{ill|Kami Ōtani Kofun Group|ja|上大谷古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kami Ōtani Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Comprises 20 kofun, with dd preserved. * {{ill|Shimo Ōtani Kofun Group|ja|下大谷古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shimo Ōtani Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Comprises 2 kofun; Mound 2 is lost, Mound 1 preserved. * {{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group (Jōyō)|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nishiyama Kofun Group (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Previously near Shimo Ōtani Kofun Group, but all lost due to development. * {{ill|Ōtake Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|大竹古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtake Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Square kofun. * {{ill|Anderayama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Anjiyama Kofun|qq=}} - Circular kofun. == Other Historical Sites == * [[:en:Hirakawa temple ruins|Hirakawa Temple Ruins]] - National Historic Site, adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * [[:en:Kuse temple ruins|Kuze Temple Ruins]] - National Historic Site. * [[:en:Shōdō Kanga ruins|Shōdō Kanga Ruins]] - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * '''Bronze Mirrors from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun''' (7 pieces) - Stored at [[:en:Sen-oku Hakuko Kan|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum]], designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Properties Database|201|9721|Bronze Mirrors from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * '''Artifacts from Shibagahara Kofun''' - Stored at Jōyō City Museum of History and Folklore, designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Properties Database|201|10078|burial goods from Shibagahara Kofun}} * '''Nagabuchi-Style Stone Coffin from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun''' - Stored at [[:en:Kyoto University|Kyoto University]], designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Properties Database|201|10083|Nagabuchi-Style Stone Coffin}} === National Historic Sites === * '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' ''' Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ''' Marutsuka Kofun ''' Bashōzuka Kofun ''' Kuze Elementary School Kofun Designated as a National Historic Site on January 19, 1979, and renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" in 2016 with the addition of Bashōzuka Kofun and Kuze Elementary School Kofun.{{National Cultural Properties Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * '''Shibagahara Kofun''' - Designated on September 6, 1989, with expanded boundaries designated on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Properties Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Jōyō City Designated Cultural Properties === * '''Artifacts from Shibagahara ddth Mound''' File:Shibagahara ddth Mound Mirror.JPG|Triangular-Rimmed Mirror with Three Deities and Four Beasts, from Shibagahara ddth Mound
{{small|Displayed at Jōyō City Museum of History and Folklore.}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kintetsu Kutsukawa Station|ja|近鉄久津川駅|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kintetsu Kutsukawa Station|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from {{ill|JR Nara Line Jōyō Station|ja|奈良線 城陽駅|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/JR Nara Line Jōyō Station|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Articles == * {{ill|List of Historic Sites of Japan (Kinki)|ja|近畿地方の史跡一覧|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Historic Sites of Japan (Kinki)|qq=}} == External Links == * {{National Cultural Properties Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} {{translated page|ja|久津川古墳群|version=100529817|comment=Imported full ja history}} {{draft categories| [[Category:Completion tier 4]] }} [[sn:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[ja:久津川古墳群]] [[sn:utsukawa Kofun Group]] [[en:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[sn:uzugawa Kofuns]] [[sn:Kuzugawa Kofuns]] {{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Cluster|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of [[kofun]] Kofuns located in [[:en:Jōyō, Kyoto|Joyo]], Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of [[:en:Kintetsu Railway|Kintetsu]]'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of Kofuns is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|qq=}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Basho-zuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuse Elementary School Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 城陽市立久世小学校}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "[[:en:Shibagahara Kofun|Shibagahara Kofun]]" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * '''{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}''' - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺|1=Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nagashigata stone coffin|13=User:Immanuelle/Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * '''{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|qq=}}''' - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * '''{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Aotsuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''' - Rectangular front and rear Kofun. * '''{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Akatsuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''' - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} adjacent to [[:en:Hirakawa temple ruins|Hirakawa Temple Ruins]]. * '''{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Basho-zuka Kofun|qq=}}''' - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * '''Kajizuka Kofun''' - Square Kofun partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * '''Shigetsuzuka Kofun''' - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|qq=}} but now lost due to construction. * '''Hakozuka Kofun''' - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * '''Yamamichi Kofun''' - Square Kofun lost due to residential development. * '''{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibagahara Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 芝ヶ原古墳}}''' - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "[[:en:Shibagahara Kofun|Shibagahara Kofun]]," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|qq=}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuse Elementary School Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 城陽市立久世小学校}}." * '''{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nitsuka Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''' - A group of seven kofun. Nos. 1–5 have been lost, while Nos. 6 and 7 are preserved. * '''Kami-Otani Kofun Group''' - A group of 20 kofun, with 11 preserved. * '''Shimo-Otani Kofun Group''' - A group of two kofun. No. 2 has been lost, while No. 1 is preserved. * '''{{ill|Nishiyama Kofun Group|ja|西山古墳群 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nishiyama Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''' - Formerly near the Shimo-Otani group but lost due to residential development. * '''Otakeshi Kofun''' - Square Kofun. * '''{{ill|Anderayama Kofun|ja|庵寺山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Anjiyama Kofun|qq=}}''' - Round Kofun. == Other Sites == * '''[[:en:Hirakawa temple ruins|Hirakawa Temple Ruins]]''' - National Historic Site adjacent to Akatsuka Kofun. * '''[[:en:Kuse temple ruins|Kuse Temple Ruins]]''' - National Historic Site. * '''[[:en:Shōdō Kanga ruins|Seido Administrative Complex Ruins]]''' - National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * '''Mirrors excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 pieces, archaeological artifacts)''' - Stored at [[:en:Sen-oku Hakuko Kan|Sen-oku Hakukokan Museum]]. Designated on November 14, 1953.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|9721|Mirrors Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} * '''Artifacts excavated from Shibagahara Kofun in Kyoto Prefecture (archaeological artifacts)''' - Stored at Joyo City Historical Museum. Designated on June 29, 1990.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10078|burial goods Excavated from Shibagahara Kofun}} * '''Nagashigata Stone Coffin excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (archaeological artifacts)''' - Stored at Kyoto University. Designated on June 21, 1991.{{National Cultural Property Database|201|10083|Nagashigata Stone Coffin Excavated from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === National Historic Sites === * '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' ''' Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ''' Marutsuka Kofun ''' Basho-zuka Kofun ''' Kuse Elementary School Kofun *: Designated on January 19, 1979, as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." *: Renamed "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster" with the inclusion of Basho-zuka and Kuse Elementary School Kofun on October 3, 2016.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * '''Shibagahara Kofun''' *: Designated on September 6, 1989. *: Boundary expanded on January 24, 2012.{{National Cultural Property Database|401|1750|Shibagahara Kofun}} === Joyo City Designated Cultural Properties === * '''Artifacts Excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun (archaeological artifacts)''' File:芝ヶ原11号墳出土 三角縁銘帯三神四獣鏡.JPG|Triangular-rimmed mirror excavated from Shibagahara No. 11 Kofun
{{small|Exhibited at the Joyo City Historical Museum (Gorikan).}} == Access == * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from [[:en:Kintetsu Railway|Kintetsu]] Kutsukawa Station. * Approximately 10–45 minutes on foot from [[:en:Nara Line (JR West)|JR West Nara Line]] Joyo Station. == References == {{Reflist}} == Sources == * [http://www.city.joyo.kyoto.jp/introduction/asset/kuni-siseki/kuni-siseki2 Official Page on Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://obito1.web.fc2.com/zyouyou.html Ancient Kofuns of Joyo City] * [https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] * [http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] * [http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] * [http://www.jpn-hayashi.com/cgi-bin/pjlist.cgi?mode=%8Es%93%E0&title0=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&title2=%82%C9%82%A0%82%E9%8C%C3%95%AD&choice1=%8Es%93%E0&area0=%8Es%93%E0&area1=%8B%9E%93s%95%7B&area2=&area3=%8F%E9%97z%8Es&item0=1&item2=54&item3=100&browser=99&colum=24&font=20&screen=240&life= List of Kofun in Joyo City] == See Also == * [[List of Historic Sites in the Kinki Region]] == External Links == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * {{National Cultural Property Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} {{Kofun navbar}} {{translated page|ja|久津川古墳群|version=100529817|comment=Imported full ja history}} {{draft categories| [[Category:Completion tier 4]] [[sn:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] }} [[sn:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[ja:久津川古墳群]] [[Category:Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster]] [[Category:Kofun of Kyoto prefecture]] [[Category:History of Joyo, Kyoto]] {{Commons category|Kutsukawa Kofun Group}} [[Category:translated pages with valid en interwikis]]

{{Infobox ancient site|coordinates={{Coord|34.86481111111111|N|135.77894166666667|E|region:JP_type:landmark|display=inline,title}}}}{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q22118592]] Wikidata name: Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:47, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Location map|Japan Kyoto|lat_deg=34|lat_min=51|lat_sec=53.32|lon_deg=135|lon_min=46|lon_sec=44.19|label=Kutsukawa
Kofun Group|position=top|width=220|Red pog.svg|marksize=10|caption={{Center|Location of the Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}}}} '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of ancient Kofuns ([[kofun]]) located in [[:en:Jōyō, Kyoto|Jōyō City]], [[:en:Kyoto Prefecture|Kyoto Prefecture]], Japan. Parts of the group have been designated as a [[:en:Historic site|Historic site of Japan]]}. It is among the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Ancient Kofuns of Jōyō City] == Overview == The Kofun Group is located in the plains and hills near the Otanigawa River, east of [[:en:Kutsukawa Station|Kutsukawa Station]], operated by [[:en:Kintetsu Railway|Kintetsu Railway]]. Narrowly, it refers to about ten mounds near the {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}, but the broader area, including smaller kofun in surrounding hills, comprises approximately 150 mounds.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide - Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Due to residential development, some mounds have been lost or are no longer visible.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online - Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Maruzuka Kofun] Originally, the {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} and the {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|lt=Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|lt=Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} were designated as "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Maruzuka Kofun" as a Historic Site of Japan. In 2016 (Heisei 28), the {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} and the {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuse Elementary School Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 城陽市立久世小学校}} were added to the designation, and the collective name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodoha11yo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Announcement of Historic Site Designation Changes]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, the [[:en:Shibagahara Kofun|Shibagahara Kofun]] has also been designated as a Historic Site of Japan under the name "Shibahara Kofun." == Main Kofun == * {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} - A [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]], the largest in the {{ill|Yamashiro Province|ja|Yamashiro Province|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamashiro Province|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} region, featuring a stone burial chest made from Tatsuyama stone. * {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|lt=Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|lt=Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} - A {{ill|Scallop-shaped kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop-shaped kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}. * {{ill|Aozuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|青塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Aozuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} - A {{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後方墳|lt=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|1=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|comment=doing this because I need to differentiate it in piped links too with my new interwiki tool as not the ambiguous phrase keyhole shaped kofun|1=zenpō-kōhō-fun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Keyhole-shaped kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/zenpō-kōhō-fun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}. * {{ill|Akazuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|赤塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Akazuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 川部・高森古墳群}} - A {{ill|Circular Kofun|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Circular Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} adjacent to the [[:en:Hirakawa temple ruins|Hirakawa Temple Ruins]]. * {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} - A [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] and part of the National Historic Site designation. * {{ill|Kajizuka Kofun|ja|梶塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kajizuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - A {{ill|Square Kofun|ja|方墳|1=Square Kofun|1=Square Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Square Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Square Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, partially overla11ing with the Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun site. * {{ill|Shibahara Kofun Group|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibahara Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 芝ヶ原古墳}} - Comprising 13 mounds, with the 12th mound designated as the "Shibahara Kofun" National Historic Site. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (National Designation) === * Mirrors excavated from the Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun (7 items) - Preserved at the [[:en:Sen-oku Hakuko Kan|Iizuka Antiquities Museum]]. Designated in 1953 (Showa 28).{{National Cultural Properties Database|201|9721|Mirrors from Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun}} === Historic Sites of Japan === * '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' ''' Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun ''' Maruzuka Kofun ''' Bashōzuka Kofun ''' Kuse Elementary School Kofun * '''Shibahara Kofun''' == Access == * A11roximately 10–45 minutes' walk from [[:en:Kutsukawa Station|Kutsukawa Station]] on the [[:en:Kyoto Line (Kintetsu)|Kintetsu Kyoto Line]]. * A11roximately 10–45 minutes' walk from [[:en:Jōyō Station|Jōyō Station]] on the [[:en:Nara Line (JR West)|JR Nara Line]]. == References == {{Reflist}} == See Also == * {{ill|List of Historic Sites of the Kinki Region|ja|近畿地方の史跡一覧|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/List of Historic Sites of the Kinki Region|qq=}} == External Links == {{Commonscat|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} * {{National Cultural Properties Database|401|1741|Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster}} The '''Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster''' (久津川古墳群) is a group of {{ill|kofun|ja|古墳群|1=Kofun cluster|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kofun cluster|qq=}} (ancient Kofuns) located in [[:en:Jōyō, Kyoto|Jōyō, Kyoto]], [[:en:Kyoto Prefecture|Kyoto Prefecture]]. Parts of the site are designated as a [[:en:Historic site|Historic site of Japan]]}. It is one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun in Jōyō City] == Overview == The kofun group is situated on flatlands and hills around the {{ill|Ōtanigawa River|ja|大谷川|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtanigawa River|qq=}} near {{ill|Kintetsu Kutsukawa Station|ja|近鉄久津川駅|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kintetsu Kutsukawa Station|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. In a narrow sense, it refers to around 10 kofun near the {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered across surrounding hills, the total is estimated to be around 150 mounds.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379 Kyoto Tourism Guide - Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Due to recent residential development, many kofun have been lost or are no longer visible.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online - Kutsukawa Kurazuka & Marutsuka Kofun] Originally, two kofun—{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Marutsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Marutsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}}—were designated as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In [[:en:2016|2016]] (Heisei 28), {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Kuze Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuze Elementary School Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 城陽市立久世小学校}} were added, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." {{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding the Designation of Historic Sites, etc.]}} (Cultural Agency Press Release, June 17, 2016).MEXT Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, the {{ill|Shibagahara 12th Mound|ja|芝ヶ原12号墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibagahara 12th Mound|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} is designated as the National Historic Site "Shibagahara Kofun." == Main Kofun == * {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} - National Historic Site. The largest [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] in the Yamashiro region, where a {{ill|nagabuchi-style stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺|1=Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/nagabuchi-style stone coffin|13=User:Immanuelle/Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=}} made of Tatsuyama stone was discovered. * {{ill|Marutsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Marutsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=}} - National Historic Site. A {{ill|scallop-shaped kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/scallop-shaped kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}. * {{ill|Aotsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Aotsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - {{ill|zenpō-kōhō-fun (front-square, rear-rounded mound)|ja|前方後方墳|lt=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|1=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|comment=doing this because I need to differentiate it in piped links too with my new interwiki tool as not the ambiguous phrase keyhole shaped kofun|1=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/zenpō-kōhō-fun (front-square, rear-rounded mound)|13=User:Immanuelle/Zenpō-kōhō-fun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}. * {{ill|Akatsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Akatsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - {{ill|circular kofun (empun)|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/circular kofun (empun)|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, adjacent to [[:en:Hirakawa temple ruins|Hirakawa Temple Ruins]]. * {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bashōzuka Kofun|qq=}} - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * {{ill|Kajitsuka Kofun|ja|梶塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kajitsuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - {{ill|square kofun (hōfun)|ja|方墳|1=Square Kofun|1=Square Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/square kofun (hōfun)|13=User:Immanuelle/Square Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, partially overlapping with Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * {{ill|Shigetsuzuka Kofun|ja|指月塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shigetsuzuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Circular kofun, formerly located on the grounds of {{ill|Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Elementary School|qq=}}; now lost due to construction. * {{ill|Hakotsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|箱塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hakotsuka Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * {{ill|Yamamichi Kofun (Jōyō)|ja|山道古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamamichi Kofun (Jōyō)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Square kofun, now lost to residential development. * {{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibagahara Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 芝ヶ原古墳}} - Comprises 13 kofun. Part of the cluster is designated as a National Historic Site and represents one of the largest kofun groups in Kyoto Prefecture.[http://mj-ktmr2.digi2.jp/p26ky/pys26207kutugawa.htm Kofun of Joyo City] == Overview == The Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster is situated in the lowlands and hills surrounding the Otanigawa River, east of [[:en:Kintetsu Railway|Kintetsu]]'s Kutsukawa Station. Narrowly defined, the cluster includes around ten kofun near {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}, but when including smaller kofun scattered throughout the nearby hills, the total number of Kofuns is estimated to be around 150.[http://www.kyoto-kankou.or.jp/info_search/?id=379&r=1441389345.907 Kyoto Tourism Guide: Joyo City Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster] Many kofun have been lost or obscured due to recent residential development.[https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/138764 Cultural Heritage Online: Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun] Previously, {{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|qq=}} were designated collectively as the National Historic Site "Kutsukawa Kurazuka and Marutsuka Kofun." In 2016, {{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Basho-zuka Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuse Elementary School Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 城陽市立久世小学校}} were added to the designation, and the name was changed to "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster."{{PDFlink|[https://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/pdf/2016061701_besshi03.pdf Regarding Designations of Historic Sites]}} (Agency for Cultural Affairs, June 17, 2016).Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 144, October 3, 2016. Separately, Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun has been designated as the National Historic Site "[[:en:Shibagahara Kofun|Shibagahara Kofun]]" and is not part of the "Kutsukawa Kofun Cluster." == Major Kofun == * '''{{ill|Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|ja|久津川車塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun|qq=}}''' - National Historic Site. The largest keyhole-shaped kofun in the cluster and one of the largest in the Yamashiro region. A {{ill|Nagashigata stone coffin|ja|長持形石棺|1=Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nagashigata stone coffin|13=User:Immanuelle/Nagamochi style stone sarcophagus|qq=}} made of Ryuzan stone was discovered here. * '''{{ill|Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|ja|丸塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maruzuka Kofun (Jōyō City)|qq=}}''' - National Historic Site. A scallop-shaped kofun. * '''{{ill|Aotsuka Kofun|ja|青塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Aotsuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''' - Rectangular front and rear Kofun. * '''{{ill|Akatsuka Kofun|ja|赤塚古墳 (城陽市)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Akatsuka Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''' - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} adjacent to [[:en:Hirakawa temple ruins|Hirakawa Temple Ruins]]. * '''{{ill|Basho-zuka Kofun|ja|芭蕉塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Basho-zuka Kofun|qq=}}''' - National Historic Site. Keyhole-shaped kofun. * '''Kajizuka Kofun''' - Square Kofun partially overlapping Kutsukawa Kurazuka Kofun. * '''Shigetsuzuka Kofun''' - {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} previously located on the grounds of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久津川小学校|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Joyo Municipal Kutsukawa Elementary School|qq=}} but now lost due to construction. * '''Hakozuka Kofun''' - Keyhole-shaped kofun. * '''Yamamichi Kofun''' - Square Kofun lost due to residential development. * '''{{ill|Shibagahara Kofun|ja|芝ヶ原古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shibagahara Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 芝ヶ原古墳}}''' - A group of 13 kofun. Shibagahara No. 12 Kofun is designated as the National Historic Site "[[:en:Shibagahara Kofun|Shibagahara Kofun]]," while Shibagahara No. 9 Kofun, located in the courtyard of {{ill|Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|ja|城陽市立久世小学校|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Joyo Municipal Kuse Elementary School|qq=}}, is designated as "{{ill|Kuse Elementary School Kofun|ja|久世小学校古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kuse Elementary School Kofun|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 城陽市立久世小学校}}." * '''{{ill|Nitsuka Kofun Group|ja|尼塚古墳群|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nitsuka Kofun Group|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''' - A group of seven kofun.
